title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
title_zh: 智能体错误数据集：扩展5万条错误—诊断对，用于失败分析和错误感知后训练

paragraphs.en: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment’s responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset ( AED ), comprising 50,228 error–diagnosis pairs from 9,961 9{,}961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families and 23 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 一次失败的 LLM 智能体运行包含比其最终奖励更多的信息：智能体可获取的观察结果、其所采取的行动以及环境的响应。 要复用这些经验进行学习，需要确定一个需要修正的决策，并测试一个具体的替代方案。 我们提出了智能体错误数据集（Agent Error Dataset, AED），其中包含来自 9,961 个源任务的 50,228 组错误诊断对，涵盖 33 个环境、19 个工具集系列以及文本型智能体系统中的 23 个策略模型。 我们保留了原始运行轨迹和执行元数据，以便在不重复原始运行的情况下，支持跨场景的故障分析和重新诊断。 我们的五阶段“智能体错误到训练”（Agentic Error-to-Training, AET）流程会收集自然发生的错误，生成诊断结果和修正建议，并将其与记录在案的证据进行核对。 如果支持重播，我们会将修正方案与在相同检查点下、采用匹配执行设置所执行的原始行动重试进行比较。 随后，我们为诊断和动作恢复分别构建独立的训练视图。

paragraphs.en: Across 3,062 3{,}062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4 % 18.4\% to 51.1 % 51.1\% , a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 1{,}656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B’s exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2 % 47.2\% to 63.6 %, averaged over three seeds on a 943 943 -case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7 % 54.7\% ; mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.
paragraphs.zh: 在 3,062 个匹配的重播对中，首次提案的修正将验证器通过率从 18.4% 提升至 51.1%，增加了 32.7 个百分点。 使用一个独立冻结的诊断版本，在 1,656 个源任务上进行全诊断微调，使 Qwen3-8B 与内部教师标签的精确步骤一致率从 47.2% 提升至 63.6%，该结果是在 943 个案例的保留集上基于三个种子计算的平均值。 此次比较中，提示最强的参考模型得分 54.7%；随着训练集规模在四个不同水平上逐步增大，平均一致率均有所提升。 在单种子条件下对智能体训练方案进行比较时，仅针对动作的修复训练在 WebShop-lite 上的得分比仅针对成功的训练高出 6.67 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Recent frontier large language models (LLMs), including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, support complex reasoning, coding and long-horizon agentic work ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) . These capabilities renew interest in how far language-model systems can generalize beyond their training tasks ( Feng et al., 2024 ) . Open-weight Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Kimi K3 broaden access to capable agent models ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Moonshot AI, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期前沿的大语言模型（LLM），包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.1，支持复杂推理、编码以及长期智能体任务（OpenAI，2026；Anthropic，2026）。 这些能力重新激发了人们的研究兴趣：语言模型系统能在多大程度上超越其训练任务实现泛化（Feng 等，2024）。 开放权重的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 Kimi K3 扩大了高性能智能体模型的获取途径（Qwen Team，2026；DeepSeek-AI，2026；Moonshot AI，2026）。

paragraphs.en: These advances extend language-model capabilities ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) to interactive software and web tasks ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) . Agent harnesses connect these models to executable tools and persistent state. OpenHands provides a composable software-agent SDK ( Wang et al., 2026c ) ; π \pi agent combines a terminal agent loop with extensible tools, model-provider interfaces and resumable sessions ( Earendil Works, 2026 ) . Through these systems, agents inspect repositories, run commands and revise solutions using tool feedback ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . Understanding failures therefore requires examining the model together with the execution system in which it acts.
paragraphs.zh: 这些进步将语言模型的能力（Zhao 等人，2026）扩展到了交互式软件和网页任务领域（Jimenez 等人，2024；Yao 等人，2022）。 智能体利用连接机制将这些模型与可执行工具和持久化状态相衔接。 OpenHands 提供了一个可组合的软件智能体 SDK（Wang 等人，2026c）；π \pi 智能体将终端智能体循环与可扩展的工具、模型提供者接口和可恢复的会话相结合（Earendil Works，2026）。 通过这些系统，智能体能够检查代码库、运行命令，并利用工具反馈修正解决方案（Qin 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2025）。 因此，要理解失败原因，就需要将模型与其运行的执行系统结合起来进行考察。

paragraphs.en: Agent post-training improves task performance by learning from interaction. AgentTuning uses reward-filtered trajectories for supervised fine-tuning ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , while RAGEN and AgentRL extend policy optimization to multi-turn environment feedback ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Yet an outcome reward alone does not specify which decision to revise or what action should replace it. Failed rollouts preserve what the agent observed, which actions it chose, and how the environment responded. We can turn these rollouts into training examples by identifying where the agent went wrong, explaining why, and proposing what it should do instead. This motivates a dataset of agent failures with diagnoses and corrections across diverse execution settings.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在训练后的优化通过从交互中学习来提升任务表现。 AgentTuning 使用经过奖励过滤的轨迹进行监督微调（Zeng 等，2024），而 RAGEN 和 AgentRL 则将策略优化扩展到多轮环境反馈（Wang 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025a）。 然而，仅凭结果奖励本身无法明确应修改哪个决策，或该决策应由何种行动替代。 失败的执行过程保留了智能体所观察到的内容、其选择的行动以及环境的响应方式。 我们可以通过识别智能体出错的位置、解释其原因，并提出替代方案，将这些执行过程转化为训练样本。 这促使我们构建一个包含多样化执行场景的智能体失败案例数据集，其中附有诊断结果和修正建议。

sents.zh: 智能体在训练后的优化通过从交互中学习来提升任务表现。

paragraphs.en: Existing work has advanced several aspects of learning from agent failures. MAST ( Cemri et al., 2026b ) characterizes failure modes, and Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) identifies responsible agents and decisive error steps. These annotations support failure analysis, but do not directly specify the actions an agent should learn instead. AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) goes further by constructing attribution data and training a diagnostic model, while AgentDebug ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) uses corrective feedback to recover from failures. Their principal learning and recovery objectives, however, differ from training an acting policy on corrected behavior. Across these resources, differences in execution settings, annotation targets, and correction evidence also make it difficult to study diagnosis and action learning on a common collection of failures. A broader resource is therefore needed to connect natural failures with explanations, proposed corrections, and execution evidence, and to support training for both diagnosis and action.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究已在多个方面推动了从智能体失败中学习的方法。 MAST（Cemri 等人，2026b）对失败模式进行了描述，而 Who&When（Zhang 等人，2025b）则识别出负有责任的智能体和关键错误步骤。 这些标注有助于失败分析，但并未直接指明智能体应学习哪些替代行动。 AgenTracer（Zhang 等人，2026a）更进一步，通过构建归因数据并训练诊断模型来实现这一目标，而 AgentDebug（Zhu 等人，2025）则利用纠正性反馈从失败中恢复。 然而，它们的主要学习和恢复目标与在修正行为上训练执行策略的目标有所不同。 在这些资源中，执行设置、标注目标和纠正证据的差异也使得难以基于统一的失败集合研究诊断和行动学习。 因此，需要一种更全面的资源，将自然发生的失败与解释、建议的纠正措施和执行证据联系起来，并为诊断和行动的联合训练提供支持。

paragraphs.en: We introduce the Agent Error Dataset ( AED ), a collection of 50,228 error–diagnosis pairs spanning 33 environments, 19 harness families and 23 23 policy models. This breadth supports failure analysis across text-based execution settings; stored traces also support re-diagnosis without new rollouts. Our Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline links diagnoses and proposed corrections to matched replay outcomes where supported, then constructs objective-specific training views (Figure 2 ). The collection counts pairs, while experiments use a separately frozen diagnosis release and distinct replay and actor cohorts (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了智能体错误数据集（Agent Error Dataset，AED），该数据集包含 50,228 个错误诊断对，覆盖 33 个环境、19 个测试框架家族和 23 个策略模型。 这种多样性支持在基于文本的执行环境中进行故障分析；存储的轨迹还支持无需重新运行即可再次诊断。 我们的智能体错误到训练（Agentic Error-to-Training，AET）流程将诊断结果和拟定的修正方案与匹配的重播结果关联（在支持的情况下），然后构建针对特定目标的训练视图（图 2）。 该数据集统计了错误对的数量，而实验则使用一个独立冻结的诊断版本以及不同的重播和智能体群体（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions connect failure analysis, correction testing and post-training . (i) A scaled collection of natural agent failures retains provenance across execution settings, supporting analysis of how failures vary with the model and harness (Section 3.3 ). (ii) AET, a pipeline for reusing failed experience , links diagnoses, corrections and optional controlled replay to separate training views. First-proposal corrections improve matched-replay pass rates by 32.7 percentage points over original-action retries (Section 5.1 ). (iii) An empirical study of error-aware post-training shows that full-diagnosis SFT on 1,656 1{,}656 source tasks raises internal exact-step teacher-label agreement from 47.2 % 47.2\% to 63.6 % across three seeds.

paragraphs.en: Understanding failures requires connecting recurring error patterns to decisions within individual runs. MAST and AdaMAST organize these patterns into taxonomies ( Cemri et al., 2026b ; Cemri et al., 2026a ) , while attribution researchers identify responsible agents and error locations ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Deshpande et al., 2025 ; Barke et al., 2026 ) , including in long traces and spans ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . To scale attribution supervision, AgenTracer trains localization models, Who&When Pro expands fault injection, and AEGIS verifies injected failures before training attribution ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Kong et al., 2026 ) . For recovery, the question extends to whether a diagnosed error persists and whether a correction helps: TrajDebug tracks error resolution and introduces TrajErrBench ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , while AgentDebug and AgentDebugX connect diagnosis to corrective execution ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) ; CUADebug applies diagnosis and repair to screenshot-based computer use ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . In AED, we use exploratory error groupings for cross-setting analysis, and link natural failures to diagnoses, proposed corrections and available replay evidence to support post-training (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 理解故障需要将重复出现的错误模式与单次运行中的决策联系起来。 MAST 和 AdaMAST 将这些模式组织为分类体系（Cemri et al., 2026b；Cemri et al., 2026a），而归因研究人员则识别出负责的智能体及错误位置（Zhang et al., 2025b；Deshpande et al., 2025；Barke et al., 2026），包括在长轨迹和跨度中（Wang et al., 2026a；Wang et al., 2026b；Chen et al., 2026；Xia et al., 2026）。 为了扩展归因监督的规模，AgenTracer 训练定位模型，Who&When Pro 扩展了故障注入方法，而 AEGIS 则在训练归因之前验证注入的故障（Zhang et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026；Kong et al., 2026）。 在恢复方面，问题进一步延伸至：已诊断的错误是否仍然存在，以及修正措施是否有效。TrajDebug 追踪错误解决过程并引入了 TrajErrBench（Qi et al., 2026），而 AgentDebug 和 AgentDebugX 则将诊断与纠正性执行联系起来（Zhu et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2026）；CUADebug 将诊断与修复应用于基于截图的计算机操作（Zhang et al., 2026b）。 在 AED 中，我们使用探索性错误分组进行跨场景分析，并将自然发生的故障与诊断结果、拟议的修正措施以及可用的重播证据联系起来，以支持训练后的分析（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: We count a run as failed when its environment adapter reports an unsuccessful terminal outcome within the allowed budget. This collection-level outcome does not locate an error: attributing an agent error requires a trace-supported, avoidable decision. Appendix D.1 distinguishes task failures, recovered tool errors and ungradable runs.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体的环境适配器在允许的预算范围内报告失败的最终结果时，我们将其运行视为失败。 这种集合级别的结果并未定位到具体错误：要归因于智能体错误，需要存在由轨迹支持且可避免的决策。 附录 D.1 区分了任务失败、已恢复的工具错误以及无法评估的运行。

paragraphs.en: A record links a failed action–observation trace to one diagnosis, its proposed correction, review decisions and available replay branches. It also records the policy, harness, debugger and information used in construction, alongside intended uses and limitations following dataset documentation practice ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) . Multiple proposals for one failure remain distinct attempts, grouped by source task for splitting and analysis. Diagnoses are free text rather than assignments to a fixed error taxonomy; error modes are induced afterwards without changing the underlying labels (Appendix G.1 ). Appendix T gives the schema and a worked example.
paragraphs.zh: 一条记录将一次失败的动作-观察轨迹与一个诊断、其建议的修正、审查决策以及可用的重播分支关联起来。 它还记录了构建过程中使用的策略、框架、调试器和信息，以及遵循数据集文档实践（Gebru 等人，2021）所说明的预期用途和局限性。 针对同一失败的多项提案仍作为独立的尝试存在，并按源任务分组以便拆分和分析。 诊断以自由文本形式呈现，而非分配给固定的错误分类体系；错误模式是在之后推导出来的，不会改变底层的标签（附录 G.1）。 附录 T 提供了该模式的定义以及一个实例演示。

paragraphs.en: AET connects five stages (Figure 2 ). (1) Collect natural failures across environments, harnesses and policies, preserving action–observation traces and screening out known infrastructure or grader faults from agent-error targets. (2) Diagnose the error location and responsible agent, with a trace-cited explanation and proposed correction, following AgentDebug ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) through AgentDebugX ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . (3) Ground the diagnosis in the student-visible trace through structural and semantic checks, recording accepted and rejected proposals. (4) Replay , where supported, tests the correction against a fresh original-action retry from the same checkpoint under matched policy, harness, budget and verifier settings. Both outcomes are retained; recovery supports a correction under those conditions, without establishing a unique root cause. (5) Build views for diagnosis SFT, recovery SFT and action preferences, each with its own evidence and split requirements (Section 4 ). Diagnosis records require no replay; recovery targets require an executed, passing continuation, and preferences require a valid shared-input comparison. Stored failures can receive additional diagnoses without new rollouts, while records that fail a view’s admission rules remain available for collection audits. Appendix D.1 gives the stage contracts and Appendix E.6 the review rubric.
paragraphs.zh: AET 连接了五个阶段（图 2）。 (1) 收集来自不同环境、执行器和策略的自然故障，保留动作–观察轨迹，并从智能体错误目标中排除已知的基础设施或评分器故障。 (2) 诊断错误位置及负责的智能体，提供基于轨迹的说明和拟议的修正方法，遵循 AgentDebug（Zhu 等人，2025）并通过 AgentDebugX（Zhu 等人，2026）。 (3) 通过结构和语义检查，将诊断依据建立在学生可见的轨迹之上，并记录被接受和被拒绝的提案。 (4) 在支持的情况下进行重演测试，使用与原始动作相同的检查点，在匹配的策略、执行器、预算和验证器设置下重新尝试，以检验修正的有效性。 两种结果均被保留；恢复机制支持在这些条件下进行修正，但并未确定唯一的根本原因。 (5) 为诊断 SFT、恢复 SFT 和动作偏好构建视图，每个视图均有独立的证据和分割要求（第 4 节）。 诊断记录无需重演；恢复目标需要一次成功执行的后续操作，而偏好则需要有效的共享输入比较。 已存储的故障无需新的运行即可接受额外的诊断，而未通过视图准入规则的记录仍可用于收集审计。 附录 D.1 提供了各阶段的契约，附录 E.6 提供了评审标准。

paragraphs.en: We check source linkage, error-step presence and trace citations before counting a pair. The environment inventory includes benchmarks, synthetic tasks and simplified ports; it is not a count of public benchmarks. An error–diagnosis pair joins one failed execution with one recorded diagnosis. Different model, seed or temperature rollouts can contribute distinct failed runs; additional diagnoses of one run add pairs, not runs. Source-task grouping keeps related executions together for splitting and uncertainty estimates. Collection membership does not imply training eligibility or a verified repair. Figure 3 shows 50,228 50{,}228 pairs linked to 38,278 38{,}278 stored source-trace blobs and 9,961 9{,}961 source tasks ( 1.31 1.31 pairs per blob). Blob identities do not establish a count of independent executions. Both panels use this index; Appendix C.2 distinguishes collection counts from training subsets.

paragraphs.en: Each preventive example pairs pre-error history with an executed passing action, ( x i , y i ) = ( h < t , a t + ) (x_{i},y_{i})=(h_{<t},a_{t}^{+}) , using the inference chat prefix. The post-error variant adds the original erroneous action and its rejection as masked context, then supervises the correction, with or without a diagnosis-derived reflection. Only state-preserving rejections enter post-error context; other repair examples use pre-error history. Neither form includes the later failed suffix. Section 5.3 specifies the success/repair mixtures.
paragraphs.zh: 每个预防性示例都将错误发生前的历史与一个已执行的通过动作配对，( x i , y i ) = ( h < t , a t + ) (x_{i},y_{i})=(h_{<t},a_{t}^{+})，并使用推理聊天前缀。 错误后变体则加入原始错误动作及其被拒绝的情况作为掩码上下文，然后对纠正过程进行监督，无论是否包含从诊断中得出的反思。 只有状态保持的拒绝操作会进入错误后上下文；其他修复示例则使用错误发生前的历史。 这两种形式都不包含后续的失败后缀。 第 5.3 节详细说明了成功与修复的混合情况。

paragraphs.en: Replay retains corrected-action and original-action outcomes, including negative and zero contrasts. A preference pair requires executed alternatives from the same state and a positive outcome contrast under the construction protocol. We evaluate SFT; the offline action-DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) pilot establishes no recovery benefit (Appendix I.15 ). Appendix Q.3 gives the loss definitions and implementation checks.

paragraphs.en: Trainable models start from Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; each study uses a frozen, objective-specific population. Internal splits hold out source tasks; we audit public overlap below. Missing or unparseable responses count as misses. Public comparisons share visible inputs and scorers within each protocol; exact-step scores use task-family macro or case-level micro averages. Seed SD measures run variability; paired task-family intervals measure evaluation sampling. Actors measure initial-state task success. Appendices I.3 and I.8 specify checkpoint selection, budgets, prompts and admission.

paragraphs.en: In a separate supplied-location study, diagnosis-guided continuation scores 31.3 % 31.3\% , versus 26.0 % 26.0\% for generic reconsideration and 18.6 % 18.6\% for replay (Figure 1 c). Its paired gain over generic reconsideration remains uncertain (Appendix H.2 ). Both studies test correction at a supplied location; neither tests autonomous detection or actor post-training. The replay cohort does not join the frozen diagnosis release. Matched-size filtering establishes no learning benefit from stricter admission under the tested recipe (Appendix X ).

paragraphs.en: AED organizes failed experience for analysis, diagnosis and corrective supervision. We find useful corrections and improved agreement with internal diagnostic labels, with protocol-dependent public transfer and mixed actor outcomes. The 50,228 50{,}228 -pair collection supports analysis across execution settings; learning results concern smaller frozen populations. Historical supervision omits policy context, and later checks do not validate it retroactively (Appendix A ). Correction utility, label validity and learned recovery each require their own evidence.
paragraphs.zh: AED 对失败经验进行整理，用于分析、诊断和纠正性监督。 我们发现有效的修正方法，以及与内部诊断标签的一致性得到改善，但具体结果取决于协议相关的公开迁移和混合执行者表现。 包含 50,228 个 50{,}228 对的数据集支持在不同执行设置下的分析；学习结果则涉及较小的冻结数据集。 历史监督忽略了策略上下文，而后续检查也无法追溯验证其有效性（附录 A）。 修正效用、标签有效性和学习到的恢复机制各自都需要独立的证据支持。

paragraphs.en: We construct AED from public benchmarks, synthetic tasks, and simulated environments to study agent behavior, without seeking to collect personal information. Repository-based tasks, such as SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , may nevertheless expose contributor names, email addresses, or identifying text in code comments and issue discussions. This source-dependent privacy risk is shared with software-engineering benchmarks and can persist in derived trajectories. Public availability alone does not establish that the content is free of personal information or unrestricted for redistribution. Any release of our data will therefore be subject to source-specific privacy review and licensing restrictions, including redaction of sensitive content and unnecessary personal identifiers while preserving required attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从公开基准、合成任务和模拟环境中构建 AED，以研究智能体的行为，而不会试图收集个人信息。 然而，基于代码库的任务（例如 SWE-bench (Jimenez et al., 2024)）仍可能暴露贡献者姓名、电子邮件地址或代码注释和问题讨论中的可识别文本。 这种依赖数据源的隐私风险同样存在于软件工程基准中，并可能延续到派生出的任务轨迹中。 仅因内容在公共领域可用，并不意味着其不包含个人信息，也不表示可以无限制地重新分发。 因此，我们数据的任何发布都将受到特定于数据源的隐私审查和许可限制，包括在保留必要署名的同时，对敏感内容和不必要的个人标识符进行删减。

sents.en: We construct AED from public benchmarks, synthetic tasks, and simulated environments to study agent behavior, without seeking to collect personal information.
sents.zh: 我们从公开基准、合成任务和模拟环境中构建 AED，以研究智能体的行为，而不会试图收集个人信息。

sents.en: Repository-based tasks, such as SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , may nevertheless expose contributor names, email addresses, or identifying text in code comments and issue discussions.
sents.zh: 然而，基于代码库的任务（例如 SWE-bench (Jimenez et al., 2024)）仍可能暴露贡献者姓名、电子邮件地址或代码注释和问题讨论中的可识别文本。

sents.en: This source-dependent privacy risk is shared with software-engineering benchmarks and can persist in derived trajectories.
sents.zh: 这种依赖数据源的隐私风险同样存在于软件工程基准中，并可能延续到派生出的任务轨迹中。

sents.en: Public availability alone does not establish that the content is free of personal information or unrestricted for redistribution.
sents.zh: 仅因内容在公共领域可用，并不意味着其不包含个人信息，也不表示可以无限制地重新分发。

sents.en: Any release of our data will therefore be subject to source-specific privacy review and licensing restrictions, including redaction of sensitive content and unnecessary personal identifiers while preserving required attribution.
sents.zh: 因此，我们数据的任何发布都将受到特定于数据源的隐私审查和许可限制，包括在保留必要署名的同时，对敏感内容和不必要的个人标识符进行删减。

paragraphs.en: The human review involved four paper authors with doctoral or AI/LLM research backgrounds who participated voluntarily. We report their judgments using anonymous rater identifiers and aggregate statistics.

We also used AI for literature discovery, design critique and illustration. We test generated code and check measured claims against sources and versioned records; automated checks and the completed AI-assisted human audit have the scopes stated in Appendices E.5 and W . Figure 2 uses author-supplied artwork. The authors take responsibility for the paper and its claims.

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis supervision requires a supported attribution; repair SFT requires an executed passing continuation with valid history, and preference learning requires comparable executed alternatives (Table 39 ). Task grouping and checks of student-visible information guide selection; they do not establish that smaller subsets are optimal. The observed gains concern frozen, objective-specific subsets and recipes; they do not measure full-collection utility or show that heterogeneous sources cannot be pooled.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断监督需要受支持的特征归因；修复 SFT 需要具有有效历史记录的已执行通过延续，而偏好学习则需要可比较的已执行替代方案（表 39）。 任务分组以及对学生可见信息的检查会指导选择；但它们并未证明较小的子集是最优的。 观察到的增益涉及冻结的、特定于目标的子集和方案；它们并未衡量完整集合的效用，也未表明异质来源无法合并使用。

paragraphs.en: The diagnosis experiments use an earlier frozen release with incomplete policy context: construction omitted policy system prompts and tool lists and predates the current semantic trace-support and expanded failure-screening checks. Replay already existed; we do not claim that all collection rows passed the later checks. We retain the original inputs and splits and identify replacement-data conditions. This does not resolve the earlier label defects (Appendix E.5 ). The completed historical human audit appears in Appendix W . These results measure learning from the recorded supervision; they do not validate the revised pipeline or the full collection.

paragraphs.en: BFCL, the largest source, supplies 11.0 % 11.0\% of pairs; the five largest environments supply 44.0 % 44.0\% . The five largest harness families supply 78.8 % 78.8\% , so the collection is broad but unevenly represented. Table 36 retains every environment and its source-task support, including benchmark adaptations and simplified tasks. paragraphs.en: MAST distinguishes failure profiles from system rankings and relates failure modes to task outcomes ( Cemri et al., 2026b ) . We extend this analysis perspective to two properties recorded by AED: what happens when an action changes, and how the diagnosis changes after an unsuccessful correction. The cohorts below have different inclusion rules; neither estimates prevalence in the final collection. AgentDebug motivates diagnosis-guided replay ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; this analysis examines the recorded outcomes, not a new repair algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: MAST 将故障特征与系统排名区分开来，并将故障模式与任务结果关联起来（Cemri 等人，2026b）。 我们将这一分析视角扩展到 AED 记录的两个属性：当某个动作发生变化时会发生什么，以及在纠正失败后诊断结果如何变化。 以下各队列的纳入规则不同；两者均未估计最终数据集中疾病的流行率。 AgentDebug 推动了以诊断为指导的重播方法（Zhu 等人，2025）；本分析考察的是记录的结果，而非新的修复算法。

sents.en: We extend this analysis perspective to two properties recorded by AED: what happens when an action changes, and how the diagnosis changes after an unsuccessful correction.

paragraphs.en: The first proposal succeeds on 1,564 1{,}564 paired attempts, but the original-action retry also succeeds on 470 470 of them ( 30.1 % 30.1\% ). The correction-only and retry-only cells contain 1,094 1{,}094 and 93 93 attempts; 1,405 1{,}405 fail in both arms. Thus the net paired gain comes from the difference between the discordant cells, not from counting all successful corrections as improvement. The existing task-clustered interval for this contrast appears in Table 47 . These observations motivate retaining successful retries and failed corrections, which distinguish passing branches from evidence for an action preference. A single paired outcome does not identify an individual causal effect, prove a repair unnecessary, or satisfy shared-state preference admission by itself.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个提案在 1,564 次配对尝试中成功，但原始动作重试也在其中 470 次中成功（30.1%）。 仅修正和仅重试的单元格分别包含 1,094 次和 93 次尝试；1,405 次尝试在两个分支中均失败。 因此，净配对收益来自不一致单元格之间的差异，而非将所有成功的修正都视为改进。 这种对比现有的任务聚类区间见第 47 表。 这些观察结果促使我们保留成功重试和失败修正，因为它们能将通过的分支与动作偏好的证据区分开来。 单个配对结果本身既无法确定个体因果效应，也无法证明修复不必要，更无法满足共享状态偏好接纳的要求。

paragraphs.en: Across 405 405 multi-round attempts, 1,064 1{,}064 of 1,744 1{,}744 adjacent diagnoses retain the same attributed step ( 61.0 % 61.0\% ); 363 363 move later and 317 317 earlier. The same-step category is the largest in each wave, rather than an artifact of pooling waves. A fixed location leaves the explanation and proposed action free to change. This argues for retaining the revision history, including unsuccessful proposals, when studying how to correct a failure. It does not establish that later diagnoses are more accurate or that more rounds cause better recovery. Table 35 reports observed later-round yield and its stopping limits.
paragraphs.zh: 在 405 次多轮尝试中，1,744 个相邻诊断中有 1,064 个保留了相同的归因步骤（61.0%）；其中 363 个步骤较晚，317 个步骤较早。 在每个波次中，“相同步骤”类别都是最大的，而不是波次合并造成的偶然现象。 固定位置使得解释和提议的行动可以自由变化。 这表明在研究如何纠正失败时，应保留修订历史，包括未成功的提议。 这并未证明后续的诊断更准确，也未证明更多轮次会导致更好的恢复。 表 35 报告了观察到的后续轮次产出及其停止极限。

paragraphs.en: In MAST, some annotated failure modes also occur in successful traces. paragraphs.en: Evidence grades let a user select diagnosis-only records, observed recoveries or repeated matched contrasts. A diagnosis whose citations cannot be resolved is ungrounded . A grounded diagnosis with neither replay nor a named checkpoint is E0 . Explicit replay-status fields also distinguish a named but unexecuted checkpoint from a completed trial; Appendix D.2 documents the legacy grading convention. Executed replacements that never succeed or succeed on only some trials are recorded as no recovery or partial recovery . E1 records an observed recovery on the replacement branch when the original action was not tested adequately or also succeeded. E2 requires at least two trials per arm and completion of both arms, with every treatment continuation passing and every matched control failing.
paragraphs.zh: 证据等级允许用户选择仅包含诊断的记录、观察到的恢复或重复的匹配对照。 无法解析其引用的诊断是无依据的。 既没有重播也没有命名检查点的有依据诊断为 E0。 显式的重播状态字段还能区分命名但未执行的检查点与已完成试验；附录 D.2 记录了旧版分级惯例。 从未成功或仅在部分试验中成功的执行替换会被记录为无恢复或部分恢复。 当原始动作未被充分测试或同样成功时，E1 会记录替换分支上观察到的恢复。 E2 要求每个分支至少进行两次试验且两个分支均完成，同时所有治疗延续必须通过，所有匹配对照必须失败。

sents.zh: 从未成功或仅在部分试验中成功的执行替换会被记录为无恢复或部分恢复。

paragraphs.en: A successful trial establishes observed recovery, not a unique root cause or a reliable effect. Even repeated contrasts depend on the restored state, policy, harness, and verifier. Grades can be recomputed from the recorded outcomes without another environment run. Appendix D gives the grading procedure and assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 一次成功的试验只能证实观察到的恢复结果，而无法确定唯一的根本原因或可靠的影响。 即使重复进行对比，其结果也取决于恢复后的状态、策略、约束条件和验证器。 无需再次运行环境，即可根据记录的结果重新计算评分。 附录 D 介绍了评分流程和相关假设。

paragraphs.en: The release contains failures that arose during agent execution. Imported natural failures can contribute diagnosis records even when their original environment cannot be restored. We list procedural stand-ins separately from the benchmarks they approximate (Appendix O ). Task-level split assignments group alternate diagnoses and replay variants together; the component-disjoint evaluation additionally separates the leakage groups defined at the freeze. We treat oversized category families separately (Appendix P ).
paragraphs.zh: 此次发布包含智能体执行过程中出现的故障。 导入的自然故障即使其原始环境无法恢复，也可能贡献诊断记录。 我们将程序性替代项与其所近似的基准测试分开列出（附录 O）。 任务级别的拆分分配将替代诊断和重播变体组合在一起；组件分离评估还进一步区分了在冻结阶段定义的泄漏组。 我们将超大的类别族单独处理（附录 P）。

paragraphs.en: We count an error–diagnosis pair when a natural failure has a diagnosis that names a candidate error step, explains it, and provides at least one quotation grounded in the failed trace. This count does not require successful replay. Records with an executed, passing correction form a smaller subset, which we report with their control outcomes and replay settings, so collection counts, diagnosis counts, and replay counts stay separate.
paragraphs.zh: 当一次自然故障的诊断能够指出一个候选错误步骤、对其进行解释，并提供至少一条基于故障轨迹的引文时，我们就计为一次错误-诊断配对。 这种计数并不要求成功重演。 包含已执行且通过验证的修正记录的集合构成一个更小的子集，我们会报告这些记录的控制结果和重演设置，因此收集次数、诊断次数和重演次数保持独立。

paragraphs.en: Who&When annotates 184 natural multi-agent failures, its three annotators spending a combined 84.3 hours on decisive steps when no fault was injected ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . In AgenTracer’s released v1.0.0 data, 1306 1306 of the 3208 3208 training rows carry an injection label; its agentic split’s responsible-agent field has one value and therefore no within-split variation ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: The latest audit links 50,228 50{,}228 structurally supported pairs across 33 33 typed environments, 19 19 harness families and 23 23 named policy models. These breadth counts use one pair index and require ten source tasks per category; model aliases share one identity. The checks verify source linkage, the recorded error step and quoted trace support, not semantic correctness or training admission. For the completion batch, we re-diagnosed source-verified stored failures with a strict-citation single judge, without an added ground-truth reference or replay. We retained one supported new diagnosis per previously unpaired source blob and preserved rejected attempts in the audit. These rows augment the collection, not the frozen training or evaluation sets. A deterministic, environment-stratified spot-check found semantic defects beyond citation support; we quarantined flagged records. This defect-finding check does not estimate accuracy or validate the remaining collection. These are collection environments, including synthetic tasks and simplified ports, not a count of independent public benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 最新的审计关联了 50,228 个结构受支持的配对（50{,}228）以及 33 个类型化环境（33）、19 个测试套件家族（19）和 23 个命名策略模型（23）。 这些广度统计使用一个配对索引，且每类需要十个源任务；模型别名共享同一标识。 这些检查验证了源数据关联、记录的错误步骤以及引用的轨迹支持，而非语义正确性或训练准入性。 对于完成批次，我们使用严格引用的单一评判者重新诊断了经源验证的已存储失败案例，未添加基准事实参考或重演。 我们为每个先前未配对的源数据块保留了一个受支持的新诊断，并将被拒绝的尝试保留在审计中。 这些行扩展了数据集，而非冻结的训练集或评估集。 一次确定性的、按环境分层的抽查发现了超出引用支持的语义缺陷；我们将标记的记录隔离处理。 这种缺陷检测检查不估算准确性，也不验证剩余数据集的有效性。 这些是数据集环境，包括合成任务和简化端口，而非独立公共基准的计数。

paragraphs.en: Other reported units include TRAIL errors, MAST traces, diagnosis rows and paired replay attempts. Step includes spans. Agree.: reported human agreement (raw rates or chance-corrected coefficients), comparing programmatic labels with humans for AEGIS and failure-mode labels for MAST. TrajErrBench reports Fleiss’ κ = .91 / .67 \kappa=.91/.67 for critical-error steps on its τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench / SWE-Bench Pro subsets, respectively ( Qi et al., 2026 , Table 5). AED reports raw preferred-step agreement of 85.5 % 85.5\% ( 59 / 69 59/69 ) under shared AI assistance. Both reviewers select a location on these 69 69 of 80 80 historical records, including preferred choices from multiple candidates. The single-step subset has 92.0 % 92.0\% agreement ( 46 / 50 46/50 ; Appendix W.1 ). Raw rates and chance-corrected coefficients are different statistics; annotation targets, sampling and assistance also differ. The agreement column does not rank resources.

paragraphs.en: Partial Exec. fix covers initial-state reruns or system interventions; AgenTracer’s oracle replay is construction-only. paragraphs.en: Kong et al. (2026) use successful executions and controlled fault injection to obtain agent/error attribution labels, then verify that the altered execution fails. This supplies a known intervention and a matched successful baseline; natural failures require separate checks of diagnosis quality. Their agent/error-set F1 measures a different target from our exact-step accuracy. We therefore do not import their reported scores into our localization tables or claim a matched training advantage over AEGIS. Such a resource comparison would require a common attribution target, compatible labels, the same base model and training budget, and an independent test set. AEGIS’s failed trajectories and AED’s error–diagnosis pairs also use different counting units. In Table 1 , Exec. fix and Ctrl. concern correction and original-action replay, not the execution checks used to validate fault injection.
paragraphs.zh: Kong 等人 (2026) 利用成功执行和受控故障注入获取智能体/错误归因标签，然后验证修改后的执行会失败。 这提供了一个已知的干预措施和一个匹配的成功基线；自然发生的失败则需要单独检查诊断质量。 他们的智能体/错误集 F1 指标衡量的目标与我们精确步骤准确率所衡量的目标不同。 因此，我们没有将他们报告的分数引入我们的定位表中，也未声称相比 AEGIS 具有匹配的训练优势。 此类资源比较需要一个共同的归因目标、兼容的标签、相同的基线模型和训练预算，以及一个独立的测试集。 AEGIS 的失败轨迹和 AED 的错误-诊断对也使用了不同的计数单位。 在表 1 中，“执行修复”和“控制”涉及修正和原始动作重演，而非用于验证故障注入的执行检查。

sents.en: Kong et al.
sents.zh: Kong 等人

paragraphs.en: AgentDebug ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) motivates diagnosis-guided recovery. Our diagnosis bridge calls AgentDebugX’s Python attribution API ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) for action blame, evidence and proposed corrections. AED provides environment adapters, evidence checks and verifier-backed paired replay. Records distinguish diagnosis engines and retain available library provenance. CUADebug ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) studies diagnosis and repair for screenshot-based computer-use agents; our collection remains text-only.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDebug（Zhu 等人，2025）倡导以诊断为指导的恢复方法。 我们的诊断桥调用 AgentDebugX 的 Python 归因 API（Zhu 等人，2026），用于确定行动责任、获取证据以及查看建议的修正方案。 AED 提供环境适配器、证据检查以及由验证器支持的配对重播功能。 记录区分了不同的诊断引擎，并保留了可用库的来源信息。 CUADebug（Zhang 等人，2026b）研究了基于截图的计算机使用智能体的诊断与修复问题；而我们的数据集仍仅限于文本内容。

sents.en: AgentDebug ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) motivates diagnosis-guided recovery.
sents.zh: AgentDebug（Zhu 等人，2025）倡导以诊断为指导的恢复方法。

sents.en: Our diagnosis bridge calls AgentDebugX’s Python attribution API ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) for action blame, evidence and proposed corrections.
sents.zh: 我们的诊断桥调用 AgentDebugX 的 Python 归因 API（Zhu 等人，2026），用于确定行动责任、获取证据以及查看建议的修正方案。

sents.en: AED provides environment adapters, evidence checks and verifier-backed paired replay.
sents.zh: AED 提供环境适配器、证据检查以及由验证器支持的配对重播功能。

sents.en: Records distinguish diagnosis engines and retain available library provenance.
sents.zh: 记录区分了不同的诊断引擎，并保留了可用库的来源信息。

sents.en: CUADebug ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) studies diagnosis and repair for screenshot-based computer-use agents; our collection remains text-only.
sents.zh: CUADebug（Zhang 等人，2026b）研究了基于截图的计算机使用智能体的诊断与修复问题；而我们的数据集仍仅限于文本内容。

paragraphs.en: Reference-solution tests identified two verifier problems in the imported environments. In AgentBench-DB, gold SQL reproduced the stored table hash for only 221 221 of 455 455 state-changing tasks, and in BFCL the ground-truth call list failed the state checker on 112 112 of 386 386 instances. Episodes on the tasks these checks flagged are quarantined; the checks did not cover every task, and the release still holds rows on tasks whose gold answer fails the grader (Appendix E.1 ). These checks test the environment ports before their outputs are used as failure labels; they do not assess the debugger’s explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 参考解决方案测试在导入的环境中发现了两个验证器问题。 在 AgentBench-DB 中，黄金 SQL 仅在 455 个状态变化任务中的 221 个任务中复现了存储表的哈希值；而在 BFCL 中，基准调用列表在 386 个实例中有 112 个未能通过状态检查器。 这些检查标记出的任务所对应的回合被隔离；这些检查并未覆盖所有任务，且发布版本仍包含那些黄金答案未通过评分器的任务中的行（附录 E.1）。 这些检查在环境端口输出被用作失败标签之前对其进行测试；它们并不评估调试器的解释。

sents.en: Reference-solution tests identified two verifier problems in the imported environments.
sents.zh: 参考解决方案测试在导入的环境中发现了两个验证器问题。

sents.en: In AgentBench-DB, gold SQL reproduced the stored table hash for only 221 221 of 455 455 state-changing tasks, and in BFCL the ground-truth call list failed the state checker on 112 112 of 386 386 instances.
sents.zh: 在 AgentBench-DB 中，黄金 SQL 仅在 455 个状态变化任务中的 221 个任务中复现了存储表的哈希值；而在 BFCL 中，基准调用列表在 386 个实例中有 112 个未能通过状态检查器。

sents.en: Episodes on the tasks these checks flagged are quarantined; the checks did not cover every task, and the release still holds rows on tasks whose gold answer fails the grader (Appendix E.1 ).
sents.zh: 这些检查标记出的任务所对应的回合被隔离；这些检查并未覆盖所有任务，且发布版本仍包含那些黄金答案未通过评分器的任务中的行（附录 E.1）。

sents.zh: 这些检查在环境端口输出被用作失败标签之前对其进行测试；它们并不评估调试器的解释。

paragraphs.en: The replay cohort used an unguided all-at-once debugger. Reference-assisted variants are recorded separately; a same-task success exists for 39.5 % 39.5\% of the failed rollouts in the reference-availability census. Paired replay uses temperature 0.2 for the first sample and 0.8 for subsequent samples, compared with 0.7 for the source rollout. The two replay arms share this schedule, but replay and source-rollout outcomes need not follow the same sampling distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 重播组使用了一个无引导的“一次性”调试器。 参考辅助变体被单独记录；在参考可用性统计中，39.5% 39.5\% 的失败展开存在同一任务的成功情况。 配对重播对第一个样本使用温度 0.2，后续样本使用 0.8，而源展开的温度为 0.7。 两个重播分支共享此计划，但重播与源展开的结果不必遵循相同的采样分布。

sents.en: The replay cohort used an unguided all-at-once debugger.
sents.zh: 重播组使用了一个无引导的“一次性”调试器。

sents.en: Reference-assisted variants are recorded separately; a same-task success exists for 39.5 % 39.5\% of the failed rollouts in the reference-availability census.
sents.zh: 参考辅助变体被单独记录；在参考可用性统计中，39.5% 39.5\% 的失败展开存在同一任务的成功情况。

sents.en: Paired replay uses temperature 0.2 for the first sample and 0.8 for subsequent samples, compared with 0.7 for the source rollout.
sents.zh: 配对重播对第一个样本使用温度 0.2，后续样本使用 0.8，而源展开的温度为 0.7。

sents.en: The two replay arms share this schedule, but replay and source-rollout outcomes need not follow the same sampling distribution.
sents.zh: 两个重播分支共享此计划，但重播与源展开的结果不必遵循相同的采样分布。

paragraphs.en: Adapters evaluate task completion using answer or result matching, executable tests, or goal-state checks. We distinguish a recorded negative outcome from a valid task-failure verdict and from a supported attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器通过答案或结果匹配、可执行测试或目标状态检查来评估任务完成情况。 我们将记录在案的负面结果与有效的任务失败判定以及被接受的原因归因区分开来。

sents.en: Adapters evaluate task completion using answer or result matching, executable tests, or goal-state checks.
sents.zh: 适配器通过答案或结果匹配、可执行测试或目标状态检查来评估任务完成情况。

sents.en: We distinguish a recorded negative outcome from a valid task-failure verdict and from a supported attribution.
sents.zh: 我们将记录在案的负面结果与有效的任务失败判定以及被接受的原因归因区分开来。

paragraphs.en: For attribution, reviewers seek the earliest supported consequential mistake with a feasible alternative, not a later symptom or a unique global root cause. They can use the resulting observation as retrospective evidence; the proposed action must respect information available before execution (Appendix E.6 ). Unsupported attributions fail semantic admission.
paragraphs.zh: 在归因时，评审者应寻找最早可证实的、具有可行替代方案的后果性错误，而非较晚出现的症状或某个独特的全局根本原因。 他们可以将由此产生的观察结果用作回顾性证据；所提议的行动必须尊重执行前已存在的信息（附录 E.6）。 无法支持的归因将未能通过语义验证。

sents.en: For attribution, reviewers seek the earliest supported consequential mistake with a feasible alternative, not a later symptom or a unique global root cause.
sents.zh: 在归因时，评审者应寻找最早可证实的、具有可行替代方案的后果性错误，而非较晚出现的症状或某个独特的全局根本原因。

sents.en: They can use the resulting observation as retrospective evidence; the proposed action must respect information available before execution (Appendix E.6 ).
sents.zh: 他们可以将由此产生的观察结果用作回顾性证据；所提议的行动必须尊重执行前已存在的信息（附录 E.6）。

sents.en: Unsupported attributions fail semantic admission.
sents.zh: 无法支持的归因将未能通过语义验证。

paragraphs.en: The collection gate checks recorded failure flags, source linkage, step presence and trace quotations. Automated screening recognizes known non-agent signatures; it does not cover every adapter-specific ungradable outcome. Thus structural collection counts do not certify semantic validity or training eligibility. Recovery targets additionally require an executed, passing continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 收集门会检查已记录的失败标志、源链接、步骤存在性以及追溯引文。 自动化筛查能够识别已知非智能体特征；但它无法涵盖所有适配器特有的不可评估结果。 因此，结构收集计数并不能证明语义有效性或训练资格。 恢复目标还需要一个已执行且通过的后续步骤。

sents.en: The collection gate checks recorded failure flags, source linkage, step presence and trace quotations.
sents.zh: 收集门会检查已记录的失败标志、源链接、步骤存在性以及追溯引文。

sents.en: Automated screening recognizes known non-agent signatures; it does not cover every adapter-specific ungradable outcome.
sents.zh: 自动化筛查能够识别已知非智能体特征；但它无法涵盖所有适配器特有的不可评估结果。

sents.en: Thus structural collection counts do not certify semantic validity or training eligibility.
sents.zh: 因此，结构收集计数并不能证明语义有效性或训练资格。

sents.en: Recovery targets additionally require an executed, passing continuation.
sents.zh: 恢复目标还需要一个已执行且通过的后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: E1 records recovery without the E2 matched-contrast requirements. Ladder grades, the schema’s historical certificate flag and multiplicity-adjusted certificates are separate fields; none establishes unique causation or global minimality.
paragraphs.zh: E1 记录恢复过程，无需满足 E2 的匹配对比要求。 阶梯等级、该模式的歷史證書標記以及經多重性調整後的證書均为独立字段；其中没有任何一个能确立独特的因果关系或全局最小性。

paragraphs.en: Structural completeness does not establish grounding, semantic validity or replay success. The separate annotation audit covers 11,116 11{,}116 diagnosis attempts; 6,381 6{,}381 ( 57.4 % 57.4\% ) pass citation grounding. Those attempts cannot be appended to the configuration funnel.
paragraphs.zh: 结构上的完整性并不能确立根基、语义有效性或重播成功。 独立的标注审计涵盖了 11,116 次诊断尝试；其中 6,381 次（57.4%）通过了引用根基验证。 这些尝试无法附加到配置漏斗中。

paragraphs.en: Panel consensus is associated with stable attribution, but citation support can still fail. The solo comparator also serves as the panel’s arbiter, and the two pipelines differ in implementation. Their agreement is not an independent correctness standard or an isolated voting effect.
paragraphs.zh: 小组共识与稳定的归因相关，但引用支持仍可能失效。 单独比较器也充当小组的仲裁者，且两种流程在实现上有所不同。 它们的共识既不是独立的正确性标准，也不是孤立投票的结果。

paragraphs.en: Admission selects an existing member’s verdict; it does not merge explanations. Its association with test–retest stability does not show that gating causes correctness. Citation grounding, reproducibility and human validity require different evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 准入机制选择现有成员的裁决，并不会合并解释。 它与重测稳定性的关联并不能说明筛选机制导致了正确性。 引用依据、可重复性和人类有效性需要不同的证据支持。

paragraphs.en: Citation format helps explain the low evidence agreement: 33 33 diagnoses carry an evidence item that is a bare event identifier. paragraphs.en: The frozen release predates the checks of student-visible support and expanded failure screening; its construction inputs omitted policy system prompts and tool lists (Appendix Q.1 ). A case-by-case audit of the frozen release rejected 37 / 60 37/60 sampled rows. Equal sampling across environments makes this a defect-finding study, not an estimate of corpus-wide prevalence. The current checks address such defects; they do not retroactively validate the frozen inputs used in Section 5 . The failure cases and filter ledger follow. The historical human-review results and protocol appear in Appendix W .
paragraphs.zh: 该冻结版本早于学生可见支持功能的检查以及失败筛查的扩展；其构建过程未包含策略系统提示和工具列表（附录 Q.1）。 对冻结版本的逐案审计拒绝了 37 / 60 个抽样行中的 37 行。 跨环境进行均等采样使本研究成为一项缺陷发现研究，而非对语料库整体流行度的估计。 当前的检查机制针对此类缺陷；但它们不会追溯验证第 5 节中使用的冻结输入。 失败案例和过滤记录如下。 历史的人工审核结果与流程见附录 W。

paragraphs.en: The review exposed incorrect tool schemas, missing instructions, and infrastructure or grading failures attributed to the policy. The frozen release also retains 54 54 rows on tasks whose reference answer fails the grader (Appendix E.1 ). Its responsible-agent labels carry a defect of the same kind: 125 125 of the 943 943 held-out rows are planner–executor transcripts whose gold agent is a unit that does not appear in them; the exporter now takes the agent from the decisive step’s actor, and the revised rubric rejects a row whose named unit did not act in the trace.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审查揭示了错误的工具模式、缺失的说明，以及归因于策略的基础设施或评分失败问题。 该冻结版本还保留了 54 行任务数据，这些任务的参考答案未能通过评分器（附录 E.1）。 其“负责智能体”标签也存在同类缺陷：在 943 行预留数据中，有 125 行为规划器-执行器对话记录，但其中标注的“黄金智能体”是一个在这些记录中并未出现的单元；当前导出程序会从决定性步骤的执行者处获取智能体信息，而修订后的评分标准则会拒绝那些命名单元未在轨迹中实际执行的操作行。

paragraphs.en: The revised rubric checks exported input and target together for attribution, evidence, repair, leakage and input faithfulness. Two model-family judges review semantic criteria after deterministic checks. In a manual disagreement sample, the stricter judge was right on 8 8 of 10 10 rows; 4 4 of those 8 8 predated explicit markers for parallel tool calls. Export corrections are recorded, and missing required evidence blocks strict admission.
paragraphs.zh: 修订后的评分标准会同时检查已导出的输入和目标内容，以评估其归属性、证据、修复情况、信息泄露以及输入忠实度。 在确定性检查之后，来自两个模型系列的评审员会对语义标准进行审查。 在一组人工分歧样本中，更为严格的评审员在 10 行数据中有 8 行的判断是正确的；而这 8 行中又有 4 行早于明确标记的并行工具调用。 导出的修正内容会被记录，而缺失的必要证据则会导致严格拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Judges receive the student view. Long inputs retain the beginning, attributed step and end; judges must reject earliest-step claims when preceding steps are omitted. Acceptance therefore need not cover every character of a long input.
paragraphs.zh: 评审员会收到学生的观点。 对于长输入，需要保留开头、归因步骤和结尾；如果前面的步骤被省略，评审员必须拒绝关于最早步骤的声明。 因此，接受判断不必涵盖长输入中的每一个字符。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 applies the fifth rubric version to revised exports of the frozen release’s three evaluated splits. The model evaluations of Section 5 used the earlier frozen inputs, so these counts describe neither a retroactively filtered evaluation nor human acceptance, and they do not redefine the 98 98 -case held-out subset frozen under the earlier (second) rubric version, before any score on it. Later collections may retain a diagnosis and its adverse verdict as metadata; retaining that record does not make it an accepted training target. Likewise, semantic acceptance and replay coverage are separate properties, not successive levels on a universal correctness scale.
paragraphs.zh: 表 9 将第五版评分标准应用于该冻结版本中三个已评估分集的修订后输出。 第 5 节中的模型评估使用了早期的冻结输入，因此这些计数既不能代表事后筛选的评估结果，也不能代表人类的接受度；它们也不会重新定义在早期（第二版）评分标准下、在任何评分之前就已冻结的 98 个保留案例子集。 后续的数据集可能会将诊断结果及其负面判定作为元数据保留下来；但保留该记录并不会使其成为被接受的训练目标。 同样，语义接受度和重播覆盖是两个独立的属性，而非一个通用正确性尺度上的先后层级。

paragraphs.en: The automated rubric has twelve items. A row must pass all except item 10, which records ambiguity without rejecting the row. Deterministic checks decide items 4 and 11; Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview) judge the remaining items after those checks. Both judges must accept each rejecting item. The human form is shorter (Appendix W ).
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评分标准包含十二项内容。 一行数据必须通过除第 10 项外的所有检查；第 10 项仅记录模糊性，而不会拒绝该行数据。 确定性检查负责判定第 4 项和第 11 项；Claude Opus 5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro（预览版）在这些检查之后对剩余项目作出判断。 两名评判者都必须接受每一项被拒绝的内容。 人类形式的描述更简短（附录 W）。

paragraphs.en: Rubric v5 also rejects later parallel calls labeled without turn-order notes and quotes that were unavailable when the action was chosen. Among 69 69 disagreements on re-admitted rows, a hand check of 10 10 found the stricter judge correct on 8 8 ; 4 4 of those involved unavailable parallel-call results. The other judge was correct on 2 2 . This targeted check is not a population accuracy estimate. The 98 98 -case evaluation subset remains frozen under v2; v5 does not redefine it. Versioned questions, full fail definitions and ordered check signatures remain in the software release. We have not measured certification rates for the corrected-contract pool or the full collection.
paragraphs.zh: Rubric v5 还拒绝后续那些在标签中未注明回合顺序、且其引用内容在动作选择时不可用的并行调用。 在 69 个关于重新接纳行的分歧中，对其中 10 个进行的人工检查发现，更严格的法官在 8 个案例中判断正确；其中 4 个涉及不可用的并行调用结果。 另一位法官在 2 个案例中判断正确。 这种有针对性的检查并非总体准确性的估计。 包含 98 个案例的评估子集在 v2 版本下保持冻结；v5 并未重新定义它。 带版本的问题、完整的失败定义以及有序的检查签名仍保留在软件发布版本中。 我们尚未测量过修正后合同池或完整集合的认证率。

paragraphs.en: Construction collects an attribution, explanation, evidence and proposed action; it does not ask for an error-type label. We induce the taxonomy afterwards and store assignments in a versioned sidecar. Relabeling adds a version without overwriting previous assignments; each version retains its definitions and executable labeling state. Error-type frequencies refer to the historical labeled cohort specified below, not the full collection. This study tests labeling reliability. Its machine assignments are neither training targets nor admission criteria.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 uses the September 6 labeling snapshot, not the current 50,228 50{,}228 -pair collection. It contains 2,604 2{,}604 distinct source trajectories, of which the machine judge classified 2,092 2{,}092 and abstained on the remainder. We count each source trajectory once, regardless of how many diagnoses it has. The figure shows harnesses with at least 20 20 attempted labels: 2,588 2{,}588 trajectories across nine harnesses; 16 16 trajectories fall outside these groups. Each composition bar divides family counts by classified trajectories, while the adjacent counts retain the attempted-label denominator. Task and environment mixtures differ, and abstentions can be selective. The profiles describe this selected cohort and do not estimate harness-caused failure rates. The labeling studies below explain why these assignments remain exploratory. Appendix B.4 reports the model and environment breakdowns from the same labels, with classification coverage beside each group.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 使用的是 9 月 6 日的标注快照，而非当前的 50,228 个成对集合。 该快照包含 2,604 条不同的源轨迹，其中机器判定了 2,092 条，其余则未作判定。 无论每条源轨迹有多少个诊断结果，我们都只计算一次。 图中展示了至少有 20 个尝试性标注的“harness”：九个“harness”中共有 2,588 条轨迹；另有 16 条轨迹不属于这些组别。 每个组合条形图将家族数量除以已判定的轨迹数，而相邻的数量则保留尝试性标注的分母。 任务与环境混合方式不同，且未作判定的情况可能具有选择性。 这些特征描述的是这一被选中的群体，而非估算由“harness”导致的失败率。 下方的标注研究解释了为何这些分配仍属于探索性质。 附录 B.4 报告了来自相同标注的模型与环境分布情况，并在每组旁标注了分类覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: A separate run applies GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek-V4-Flash to 400 400 sequentially selected items from the annotation queue under the same seed taxonomy and a 12,000 12{,}000 -character tail window. At least one judge abstains on 43 43 items, leaving 357 357 jointly classified items. The two machine judges agree on 154 / 357 154/357 modes ( 43.1 % 43.1\% ): Cohen’s κ = 0.313 \kappa=0.313 at mode level and κ = 0.329 \kappa=0.329 after collapsing to families, agreement between two models rather than between human annotators. Of 203 203 mode disagreements, 186 186 cross family boundaries. The largest directed confusion is premature termination to ignored planning constraint ( 29 29 cases), with 9 9 in the reverse direction.
paragraphs.zh: 一次独立的运行中，在相同的种子分类体系和 12,000 字符的尾部窗口下，GPT-5 mini 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 被依次应用于从标注队列中选取的 400 个条目。 至少有 1 名评判员对 43 个条目弃权，最终留下 357 个共同分类的条目。 两个机器评判员在 154/357 种模式上达成一致（43.1%）：模式层面的 Cohen’s κ = 0.313，合并为家族后的 κ = 0.329；这种一致性存在于两个模型之间，而非人类标注员之间。 在 203 种模式分歧中，有 186 种跨越了家族边界。 最大的单向混淆是过早终止而忽略了规划约束（29 个案例），反向情况则有 9 个。

paragraphs.en: Thus family aggregation does little to resolve the disagreement. These figures describe a limited, nonrandom cohort, conditional on both judges assigning a mode; they do not measure agreement with human judgments. We retain the labels as exploratory machine assignments, not validated training targets or estimates of corpus-wide semantic error prevalence. Mechanical trace phenotypes and executed repair evidence remain separate measurements. The confusion-matrix counts and both κ \kappa values were recomputed from the aggregate agreement record; the raw judge responses were not independently recounted.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这种家庭聚合对解决分歧几乎没有任何帮助。 这些数据描述的是一个有限且非随机的群体，其前提条件是两名法官都分配了某种模式；它们并未衡量与人类判断的一致性。 我们将这些标签保留为探索性的机器分配结果，而非经过验证的训练目标或语料库范围内语义错误普遍性的估计值。 机械痕迹表型与已执行的修复证据仍然是两个独立的测量指标。 混淆矩阵中的计数以及两个 κ \kappa 值均根据汇总的一致性记录重新计算得出；原始法官的回应并未被独立地重新统计。

paragraphs.en: The following breakdowns use search-selected proposals, not the first proposals in Table 47 . Under the harness that produced the failure, with its state fully restored ( 871 871 pairs, 456 456 tasks), the difference is 47.1 47.1 points [ 42.3 42.3 , 51.7 51.7 ]; a substituted ReAct (single) harness continued 1846 1846 pairs ( + 43.5 +43.5 points) and 345 345 had only partly restored multi-agent state ( + 50.7 +50.7 points; Table 14 below). Table 13 breaks the selected-proposal result down by environment. Every environment with at least one discordant pair favours the proposed replacement; the one environment omitted from the rows contributed a single attempt with no discordant pair. The attempt population matches Table 47 , but proposal selection and the paired control outcomes differ; these are not strata of its first-proposal effect. We retain one occurrence per diagnosis ID, choosing the first path in lexicographic order. paragraphs.en: Table 14 splits the same 3062 3062 pairs by how the continuation was run, using the provenance the replay runner recorded on every attempt. Both arms of a pair use the same continuation policy, harness, budget and temperature schedule; selection and state-fidelity limits remain, and the strata differ in continuation harness and completeness of state restoration. 871 871 pairs ran under the harness that produced the failure from a fully restored state and speak about that system directly. 1846 1846 pairs ran under a substituted ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) (single) harness because the source harness (smolagents, Pydantic AI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or Multi-agent (planner–executor)) is not supported by the replay runner; they identify the effect of the replacement under the substituted continuation, not under the harness that failed. 345 345 pairs are marked as having incompletely restored multi-agent state, so their pre-action state was reconstructed in part. All three strata show positive selected-proposal contrasts. Their estimates are distinct from the first-proposal contrast highlighted in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 表14根据续写运行的方式，将相同的3062对数据进行了划分，其中使用了重播运行器在每次尝试中记录的数据来源信息。 每一对的两个分支都使用相同的续写策略、框架、预算和温度调度；选择和状态保真度限制仍然存在，而各分层在续写框架和状态恢复的完整性方面有所不同。871对数据在从完全恢复的状态引发失败的框架下运行，并直接描述了该系统的情况。1846对数据在替代的ReAct（Yao等，2023）（单一）框架下运行，因为原始框架（smolagents、Pydantic AI、AutoGen、LangGraph或Multi-agent（规划器–执行器））不受重播运行器的支持；它们识别的是替代续写方式下的影响，而非导致失败的框架本身的影响。345对被标记为多智能体状态恢复不完整，因此其行动前的状态仅部分重建。 所有三个分层都显示出积极的所选提案对比。 它们的估计值与主文中强调的首个提案对比有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Two counts bound how the paired continuation of Section 5 could be read as an artefact of the budget rather than of the action: only 11 11 of the 3062 3062 attempts merely exhausted their step budget, and none of those sits in the cell where only the original action passed; the eleventh environment in the corpus contributed a single attempt and no discordant pair, which is why Table 13 reports ten.
paragraphs.zh: 两个计数说明了为何第5节的成对延续可以被解读为预算的产物，而非行动的产物：在3062次尝试中，仅有11次尝试用尽了其步骤预算，且这些尝试中没有任何一次出现在仅原始行动通过的那个单元格中；语料库中的第十一环境贡献了一次尝试且没有不匹配的对，因此表13报告的是十次。

paragraphs.en: The paired continuation in Section 5 tests a proposed replacement against its original action; it does not measure the benefit of training a debugger.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 节中的配对延续测试了所提议的替换方案与其原始动作之间的差异；它并未衡量训练调试器所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: The located-recovery cohort of Table 27 was frozen before execution: 150 150 attempts drawn from 1235 1235 eligible, one per source task, across 11 11 environments, with the selection rule and the analysis rules stored in the cohort file and carried into every results file written against it. Arm order is randomised within an attempt. The rules require that every planned trajectory stay in the denominator, that infrastructure outcomes get their own column rather than being folded into either arm, and that an unknown-as-failure sensitivity be reported beside the complete-case result, because a crash can be caused by the intervention it is scored under.
paragraphs.zh: 表27中的定位恢复队列在执行前已被冻结：从1235个符合条件的尝试中抽取了150次尝试，每个源任务各一次，覆盖11个环境；选择规则和分析规则均存储于队列文件中，并带入所有基于该队列生成的结果文件。 各分支的顺序在每次尝试中是随机化的。 这些规则要求：所有规划好的轨迹必须保留在分母中；基础设施结果需单独设列，而非并入任一分支；且必须在完整病例结果旁报告“未知即失败”的敏感性分析，因为系统崩溃可能由其所评估的干预措施引起。

paragraphs.en: Counting every attempt and scoring a crash as a failure moves the four arms to 18.6 18.6 , 26.0 26.0 , 31.3 31.3 and 35.3 35.3 per cent, against the complete-case 18.7 18.7 , 27.1 27.1 , 32.2 32.2 and 36.1 36.1 ; the ordering and the reading of the section do not change. The exact McNemar test on attempts binarised as "recovered at least once" agrees with the intervals where they are far from zero ( p = 0.024 p=0.024 for the diagnosis against re-application, p = 0.001 p=0.001 for the deployed text) and not where they are close ( p = 0.42 p=0.42 for the content-free nudge, p = 0.12 p=0.12 for the content effect); it discards the per-attempt rates and the task clustering the intervals use, and is reported as a supplementary check rather than as the inference.
paragraphs.zh: 将每次尝试都计入，并将崩溃计为一次失败，则四个手臂的百分比分别为 18.6、26.0、31.3 和 35.3，而完整样本组的数据则为 18.7、27.1、32.2 和 36.1；排序以及该部分的解读方式均保持不变。 对尝试次数进行二值化（定义为“至少恢复过一次”）后的精确 McNemar 检验结果，与那些数值远离零的区间一致（诊断与重新申请之间的 p = 0.024，已部署文本的 p = 0.001），而与数值接近零的区间不一致（无内容提示的 p = 0.42，内容效应的 p = 0.12）；该检验忽略了每次尝试的比率以及区间所依赖的任务聚类，因此仅作为补充性检查报告，而非主要推断依据。

The content-free arm sends "Reconsider your next action."; the clean arm appends the recorded explanation and directive; the deployed arm replaces the opening with "Your previous attempt failed." and calls the explanation a diagnosis of a mistake the actor is about to make. Every branch stamps the framing it received, and the run is rejected if any branch stamps a framing other than its arm’s; the reported run has no such mismatch. The earlier continuation cap exhausted the reasoning budget in 52 52 of 450 450 coached continuations, compared with 13 13 after correction. That superseded run estimated the content effect at + 0.8 +0.8 points ( − 6.3 -6.3 to 7.8 7.8 ); we use the corrected run’s + 5.6 +5.6 ( 0.0 0.0 to 11.3 11.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这四个分支仅在行动前状态中的提示文本上有所不同。 无内容分支发送“请重新考虑你的下一步行动”；纯净分支则附加记录的解释和指令；部署分支则将开头替换为“你之前的尝试失败了”，并将解释称为对行动者即将犯下的错误的诊断。 每个分支都会打上其收到的框架标记，如果任何分支打上的框架与其所属分支的框架不同，该运行将被拒绝；而报告中的运行不存在此类不匹配。 在 450 个经过提示的延续中，早期的延续上限在 52 次尝试中就用尽了推理预算，而修正后仅需 13 次。 那个被取代的运行估计内容效应为 +0.8 分（从 -6.3 到 7.8）；我们使用修正后运行的 +5.6 分（从 0.0 到 11.3）。

paragraphs.en: Both resources improve joint attribution on AgenTracer’s test split, where the responsible agent varies. Neither establishes an exact-step gain on the other’s test set. paragraphs.zh: 这两种资源都在 AgenTracer 的测试分割集上提升了联合归因效果，而该测试集中负责的智能体各不相同。 两者在各自的测试集上均未实现比对方更高的精确步数增益。 在我们的预留数据集上，联合得分也会奖励对恒定单位标签的匹配；AED 在精确步数方面并未优于基础模型，且 3 个种子区间中有 3 个包含零值。

sents.zh: 对比值是基于种子的均值；括号内的数值给出了每个种子最宽的 95% 百分位自助区间（跨越源任务或问题标识符），而非均值的置信区间。

sents.en: All intervals are nominal.
sents.zh: 所有区间均为名义区间。

paragraphs.en: This section reports completed training comparisons and their evaluation protocols, including gains and regressions.
paragraphs.zh: 本节报告了已完成训练的对比及其评估协议，包括性能提升与退化情况。

paragraphs.en: Table 48 reports Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) and TrajErrBench ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , whose labels originate outside this project. Their transfer results differ: over TrajErrBench’s 486 486 cases the untrained base scores 18.72 % 18.72\% while the three seeds score 15.43 15.43 , 15.43 15.43 and 20.99 % 20.99\% , so two of the three regress. We report both rather than the favourable one alone. The two benchmarks differ in what a step is – Who&When labels the decisive step of a multi-agent transcript, TrajErrBench the first faulty step of a single-agent trajectory – and we did not measure which of those differences drives the sign. Different annotators do not establish task-disjoint transfer; the task-overlap sensitivity below further limits that interpretation. Both cohorts score every case, with an unparseable answer counted as a miss. For both benchmarks, the producer maps the three trained evaluation runs to the checkpoints reported in Table 48 and records a common training-data digest. This mapping has not been independently verified against the weights loaded for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 表 48 报告了 Who&When（Zhang 等人，2025b）和 TrajErrBench（Qi 等人，2026），其标签来自本项目之外。 它们的迁移结果存在差异：在 TrajErrBench 的 486,486 个案例中，未经训练的基线模型得分为 18.72%，而三个种子模型的得分分别为 15.43%、15.43% 和 20.99%，因此其中两个模型的结果出现了回归。 我们同时报告了这两个结果，而非仅报告有利的一个。 这两个基准测试在“步骤”的定义上有所不同——Who&When 将多智能体对话中的决定性步骤作为标签，而 TrajErrBench 则将单智能体轨迹中的第一个错误步骤作为标签——但我们并未测量这些差异中哪一个导致了结果符号的不同。 不同的标注者并未证实任务无关的迁移能力；下文关于任务重叠敏感性的分析进一步限制了这种解释的可能性。 两个数据集都对每个案例进行了评分，无法解析的答案则计为错误。 对于这两个基准测试，生成方将三次训练后的评估运行与表 48 中报告的检查点进行了映射，并记录了共同的训练数据摘要。 这种映射尚未通过与评估时加载的权重进行独立验证。

paragraphs.en: An audit after the original evaluations found shared task identities or exact goals between training and Who&When. The audit did not flag trajectory overlap at its stated similarity threshold. Absence of such a hit does not rule out other overlap. We rescore the existing predictions, keeping each student paired with the base on the same cases; no model or prompt is retuned.
paragraphs.zh: 在原始评估之后进行的一项审计发现，训练数据与 Who&When 之间存在共享的任务身份或完全相同的目标。 该审计在其声明的相似性阈值下并未标记出轨迹重叠的情况。 没有发现此类匹配并不意味着不存在其他重叠情况。 我们重新评分现有的预测结果，保持每位学生与基于相同案例的基础模型配对；没有任何模型或提示被重新调整。

sents.en: An audit after the original evaluations found shared task identities or exact goals between training and Who&When.
sents.zh: 在原始评估之后进行的一项审计发现，训练数据与 Who&When 之间存在共享的任务身份或完全相同的目标。

sents.en: The audit did not flag trajectory overlap at its stated similarity threshold.
sents.zh: 该审计在其声明的相似性阈值下并未标记出轨迹重叠的情况。

sents.zh: 没有发现此类匹配并不意味着不存在其他重叠情况。

sents.zh: 我们重新评分现有的预测结果，保持每位学生与基于相同案例的基础模型配对；没有任何模型或提示被重新调整。

paragraphs.en: The larger improvement occurs on shared tasks. All three point estimates remain positive on the unflagged cases, but their seed-mean interval includes zero; the original headline does not establish transfer beyond task overlap. Task identity and normalized goals define the flagged Who&When cases. The wider audit also checks goal-text containment and trajectory shingles, with matching rules and per-case decisions retained in the companion artifacts. Removing flagged TrajErrBench cases does not reverse its negative seed-mean contrast. These are retrospective sensitivity analyses, not results from decontaminated retraining, which the two paragraphs below report.
paragraphs.zh: 在共享任务中，改进效果更为显著。 在所有未标记的案例中，三个点估计值均保持正值，但其种子均值区间包含零；原始标题并未证明能力能够超越任务重叠范围进行迁移。 任务身份和标准化目标定义了被标记的“谁与何时”案例。 更广泛的审计还检查了目标文本的包含关系和轨迹分片，匹配规则及每个案例的具体决策均保留在配套材料中。 移除被标记的 TrajErrBench 案例并不会逆转其负面的种子均值对比结果。 这些是回顾性敏感性分析，而非经过净化重新训练后的结果，后者的结果将在以下两段中报告。

sents.en: The larger improvement occurs on shared tasks.
sents.zh: 在共享任务中，改进效果更为显著。

sents.en: All three point estimates remain positive on the unflagged cases, but their seed-mean interval includes zero; the original headline does not establish transfer beyond task overlap.
sents.zh: 在所有未标记的案例中，三个点估计值均保持正值，但其种子均值区间包含零；原始标题并未证明能力能够超越任务重叠范围进行迁移。

sents.zh: 移除被标记的 TrajErrBench 案例并不会逆转其负面的种子均值对比结果。

paragraphs.en: After replacing flagged training rows, we repeat the larger-arm recipe with all planned seeds. Under the pre-specified item-bootstrap rule and original base decode, the Who&When mean exact-step contrast is + 7.79 +7.79 pp ( 95 % 95\% interval [ 1.45 , 14.31 ] [1.45,14.31] ). We retain this protocol-specific result alongside the original overlap sensitivity. The new comparison does not rescue the losses under other evaluation interfaces (Table 16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在替换被标记的训练行后，我们使用所有计划中的种子重复执行“较大臂”方案。 根据预指定的项目自助规则和原始基础解码，“谁与何时”的平均精确步骤对比为 +7.79（+7.79 个百分点），95% 置信区间为 [1.45, 14.31]。 我们保留这一特定于该协议的结果，同时保留原始的重叠敏感性。 新的比较并未在其他评估界面下挽回损失（表 16）。

sents.en: After replacing flagged training rows, we repeat the larger-arm recipe with all planned seeds.
sents.zh: 在替换被标记的训练行后，我们使用所有计划中的种子重复执行“较大臂”方案。

sents.en: Under the pre-specified item-bootstrap rule and original base decode, the Who&When mean exact-step contrast is + 7.79 +7.79 pp ( 95 % 95\% interval [ 1.45 , 14.31 ] [1.45,14.31] ).
sents.zh: 根据预指定的项目自助规则和原始基础解码，“谁与何时”的平均精确步骤对比为 +7.79（+7.79 个百分点），95% 置信区间为 [1.45, 14.31]。

sents.en: We retain this protocol-specific result alongside the original overlap sensitivity.
sents.zh: 我们保留这一特定于该协议的结果，同时保留原始的重叠敏感性。

sents.en: The new comparison does not rescue the losses under other evaluation interfaces (Table 16 ).
sents.zh: 新的比较并未在其他评估界面下挽回损失（表 16）。

paragraphs.en: We keep the original and later base decodes: one shared base response set does not measure decode variability. With the later base and source-task resampling, the Who&When mean contrast remains positive. The unified AEB base is the original decode. Raw-answer, input-hash and declared-checkpoint checks pass for the full panel; served paths do not attest loaded weight bytes. Replacing rows changes training examples and optimization paths, so these comparisons do not isolate a causal contribution of overlap or bound its share of the original gain. We retain both original and retrained results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留原始结果和后续基础解码结果：一个共享的基础响应集合无法衡量解码的变异性。 在后续基础模型和源任务的重采样之后，Who&When 的平均对比值仍然为正。 统一的 AEB 基础模型即为原始解码结果。 完整面板通过了原始答案、输入哈希和声明检查点的验证；但服务路径无法证明已加载的权重字节数。 替换行会改变训练样本和优化路径，因此这些比较无法单独识别重叠部分的因果贡献，也无法界定其占原始增益的比例。 我们同时保留了原始结果和重新训练后的结果。

sents.en: We keep the original and later base decodes: one shared base response set does not measure decode variability.
sents.zh: 我们保留原始结果和后续基础解码结果：一个共享的基础响应集合无法衡量解码的变异性。

sents.en: With the later base and source-task resampling, the Who&When mean contrast remains positive.
sents.zh: 在后续基础模型和源任务的重采样之后，Who&When 的平均对比值仍然为正。

sents.en: The unified AEB base is the original decode.
sents.zh: 统一的 AEB 基础模型即为原始解码结果。

sents.en: Raw-answer, input-hash and declared-checkpoint checks pass for the full panel; served paths do not attest loaded weight bytes.
sents.zh: 完整面板通过了原始答案、输入哈希和声明检查点的验证；但服务路径无法证明已加载的权重字节数。

sents.en: Replacing rows changes training examples and optimization paths, so these comparisons do not isolate a causal contribution of overlap or bound its share of the original gain.
sents.zh: 替换行会改变训练样本和优化路径，因此这些比较无法单独识别重叠部分的因果贡献，也无法界定其占原始增益的比例。

sents.en: We retain both original and retrained results.
sents.zh: 我们同时保留了原始结果和重新训练后的结果。

paragraphs.en: We also compare each replacement-data model with the original model from the same training seed. All three planned runs completed. The training total remains 1,656 1{,}656 rows: 1,574 1{,}574 retained and 82 82 replaced, including 30 30 training rows associated with the Who&When overlap audit. Evaluation uses the full 184 184 -case Who&When cohort, not just the 35 35 flagged evaluation cases. The replacement-minus-original changes are − 1.63 -1.63 pp for seed 17 17 ( 95 % 95\% interval [ − 3.53 , 1.59 ] [-3.53,1.59] ), + 2.17 +2.17 for seed 202 202 ( [ − 2.26 , 5.67 ] [-2.26,5.67] ), and − 1.09 -1.09 for seed 828 828 ( [ − 5.26 , 3.50 ] [-5.26,3.50] ). No per-seed interval excludes zero; the nominal paired p p values are 0.45 0.45 , 0.42 0.42 and 0.80 0.80 . All six models satisfy the answer contract on all cases. Each interval conditions on one pair of trained checkpoints. All seeds use the same original and replacement datasets, so they assess this fixed replacement scheme across training runs. The comparison measures sensitivity to replacing flagged examples; it does not identify their causal contribution to the original gain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将每个替换数据模型与来自相同训练种子的原始模型进行比较。 所有三个计划中的运行均已完成。 总训练行数仍为 1,656 1{,}656 行：其中 1,574 1{,}574 行为保留，82 82 行为替换，包括与“谁与何时”重叠审计相关的 30 30 个训练行。 评估使用了完整的 184 184 例“谁与何时”队列，而不仅仅是 35 35 个被标记的评估案例。 替换模型与原始模型的变化分别为：种子 17 17 为 −1.63 -1.63 pp（95% 95\% 置信区间 [−3.53, 1.59] [-3.53,1.59]），种子 202 202 为 +2.17 +2.17（[−2.26, 5.67] [-2.26,5.67]），种子 828 828 为 −1.09 -1.09（[−5.26, 3.50] [-5.26,3.50]）。 没有任何一个种子的置信区间排除零；名义上的配对 p 值分别为 0.45 0.45、0.42 0.42 和 0.80 0.80。 所有六个模型在所有案例上均满足答案契约。 每个置信区间都以一对训练检查点为条件。 所有种子都使用相同的原始数据集和替换数据集，因此它们评估了该固定替换方案在不同训练运行中的表现。 这种比较衡量了替换被标记样本的敏感性，但并未识别这些样本对原始增益的因果贡献。

sents.en: We also compare each replacement-data model with the original model from the same training seed.
sents.zh: 我们还将每个替换数据模型与来自相同训练种子的原始模型进行比较。

sents.en: All three planned runs completed.
sents.zh: 所有三个计划中的运行均已完成。

sents.en: No per-seed interval excludes zero; the nominal paired p p values are 0.45 0.45 , 0.42 0.42 and 0.80 0.80 .
sents.zh: 没有任何一个种子的置信区间排除零；名义上的配对 p 值分别为 0.45 0.45、0.42 0.42 和 0.80 0.80。

sents.en: All six models satisfy the answer contract on all cases.
sents.zh: 所有六个模型在所有案例上均满足答案契约。

sents.en: Each interval conditions on one pair of trained checkpoints.
sents.zh: 每个置信区间都以一对训练检查点为条件。

sents.en: All seeds use the same original and replacement datasets, so they assess this fixed replacement scheme across training runs.
sents.zh: 所有种子都使用相同的原始数据集和替换数据集，因此它们评估了该固定替换方案在不同训练运行中的表现。

paragraphs.en: We restored the complete source policy text in the same airline and retail cases, keeping other messages, labels, checkpoints and decoding settings fixed. This post-hoc input check does not replace the primary evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同的航空公司和零售案例中恢复了完整的源策略文本，同时保持其他消息、标签、检查点和解码设置不变。 这种事后的输入检查不能替代主要评估。

sents.en: We restored the complete source policy text in the same airline and retail cases, keeping other messages, labels, checkpoints and decoding settings fixed.
sents.zh: 我们在相同的航空公司和零售案例中恢复了完整的源策略文本，同时保持其他消息、标签、检查点和解码设置不变。

sents.en: This post-hoc input check does not replace the primary evaluation.
sents.zh: 这种事后的输入检查不能替代主要评估。

paragraphs.en: Restoring policy text does not yield a consistent student improvement: one seed improves and two decline. The base also loses accuracy, so a smaller student–base gap under this input does not show better student localization. New-run raw responses reproduce both scoring passes, with runtime paths and checkpoint-file hashes recorded. Historical base raw generations remain unavailable. The comparison does not exclude other context effects or identify the cause of transfer loss.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复策略文本并未带来一致的学生表现提升：一个种子模型表现提升，而另外两个则下降。 基础模型也出现了准确性下降，因此在此输入条件下学生与基础模型之间的差距缩小，并不意味着学生定位能力有所改善。 新运行的原始响应再现了两次评分通过的情况，同时记录了运行时的路径和检查点文件的哈希值。 历史基础模型的原始生成结果仍然无法获取。 该比较并未排除其他上下文效应，也未确定迁移损失的具体原因。

sents.en: Restoring policy text does not yield a consistent student improvement: one seed improves and two decline.
