paragraphs.en: We fine-tune all parameters of Qwen3-8B in BF16 with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , cosine decay, 3 % 3\% warmup and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 . Table 18 reports the completed run manifests; no rows were dropped. For diagnosis, we average target-token loss within each task and then across tasks. For actors, we average over target tokens in each optimizer window; an example is one supervised assistant turn. We mask the input context in both recipes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 BF16 格式下，使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）对所有 Qwen3-8B 的参数进行微调，学习率设为 10^{-5}，采用余弦衰减、3% 的预热阶段，并将梯度裁剪值设为 1.0。 表 18 报告了已完成运行的详细信息；没有删除任何行。 为了进行诊断，我们对每个任务内的目标令牌损失求平均，然后再跨任务求平均。 对于智能体，我们在每个优化器窗口内的目标令牌上求平均；一个例子是一次有监督的助手交互回合。 我们在两种方案中都掩码了输入上下文。

sents.en: We fine-tune all parameters of Qwen3-8B in BF16 with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , cosine decay, 3 % 3\% warmup and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
sents.zh: 我们在 BF16 格式下，使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）对所有 Qwen3-8B 的参数进行微调，学习率设为 10^{-5}，采用余弦衰减、3% 的预热阶段，并将梯度裁剪值设为 1.0。

sents.en: Table 18 reports the completed run manifests; no rows were dropped.
sents.zh: 表 18 报告了已完成运行的详细信息；没有删除任何行。

sents.en: For diagnosis, we average target-token loss within each task and then across tasks.
sents.zh: 为了进行诊断，我们对每个任务内的目标令牌损失求平均，然后再跨任务求平均。

sents.en: For actors, we average over target tokens in each optimizer window; an example is one supervised assistant turn.
sents.zh: 对于智能体，我们在每个优化器窗口内的目标令牌上求平均；一个例子是一次有监督的助手交互回合。

sents.en: We mask the input context in both recipes.
sents.zh: 我们在两种方案中都掩码了输入上下文。

paragraphs.en: Each GPU processes one example per microbatch. Diagnosis uses six GPUs with two accumulation steps, except the 948-task seeds 202 and 828, which use four GPUs with three steps. The actor runs use eight GPUs with two steps and zero-loss padding for the last optimizer window of each epoch. We select diagnosis checkpoints on development family-macro exact-step accuracy with thinking disabled, requiring at least 80 % 80\% parseability. Within 1 1 point of the best, we prefer fewer epochs, then the lower learning rate. All six 948- and 1,656-task runs select epoch 2; Appendix I.11 reports the smaller scaling arms. Actors use the final checkpoint. The actor mixtures differ in task coverage and optimization budget; the longer success-only run is a duration sensitivity, not a matched-budget control.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 GPU 每微批次处理一个样本。 诊断任务使用六个 GPU 和两个累积步骤，但 948 任务中的种子 202 和 828 除外，它们使用四个 GPU 和三个步骤。 演员运行使用八个 GPU 和两个步骤，并对每个周期最后一个优化器窗口进行零损失填充。 我们在禁用思考的情况下，基于开发集 family-macro 精确步骤准确率选择诊断检查点，要求解析能力至少达到 80 % 80\%。 在最佳结果 1 1 分以内，我们优先选择周期更少的方案，其次选择学习率较低的方案。 所有六个 948 和 1,656 任务的运行都选择了第 2 个周期；附录 I.11 报告了较小的扩展分支。 演员使用最终检查点。 演员混合模型在任务覆盖范围和优化预算上有所不同；时间更长的“仅成功”运行是持续时间敏感性的体现，而非匹配预算的对照实验。

sents.en: Each GPU processes one example per microbatch.
sents.zh: 每个 GPU 每微批次处理一个样本。

sents.en: Diagnosis uses six GPUs with two accumulation steps, except the 948-task seeds 202 and 828, which use four GPUs with three steps.
sents.zh: 诊断任务使用六个 GPU 和两个累积步骤，但 948 任务中的种子 202 和 828 除外，它们使用四个 GPU 和三个步骤。

sents.en: The actor runs use eight GPUs with two steps and zero-loss padding for the last optimizer window of each epoch.
sents.zh: 演员运行使用八个 GPU 和两个步骤，并对每个周期最后一个优化器窗口进行零损失填充。

sents.en: We select diagnosis checkpoints on development family-macro exact-step accuracy with thinking disabled, requiring at least 80 % 80\% parseability.
sents.zh: 我们在禁用思考的情况下，基于开发集 family-macro 精确步骤准确率选择诊断检查点，要求解析能力至少达到 80 % 80\%。

sents.en: Within 1 1 point of the best, we prefer fewer epochs, then the lower learning rate.
sents.zh: 在最佳结果 1 1 分以内，我们优先选择周期更少的方案，其次选择学习率较低的方案。

sents.en: All six 948- and 1,656-task runs select epoch 2; Appendix I.11 reports the smaller scaling arms.
sents.zh: 所有六个 948 和 1,656 任务的运行都选择了第 2 个周期；附录 I.11 报告了较小的扩展分支。

sents.en: Actors use the final checkpoint.
sents.zh: 演员使用最终检查点。

sents.en: The actor mixtures differ in task coverage and optimization budget; the longer success-only run is a duration sensitivity, not a matched-budget control.
sents.zh: 演员混合模型在任务覆盖范围和优化预算上有所不同；时间更长的“仅成功”运行是持续时间敏感性的体现，而非匹配预算的对照实验。

paragraphs.en: Table 48 compares full-diagnosis fine-tuning with prompted models on the frozen holdout. Both the unfiltered and certified-subset full-diagnosis rows have completed evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 表 48 比较了在冻结保留集上全诊断微调模型与提示模型的表现。 未经过滤和经认证子集的全诊断行均已完成评估。

sents.en: Table 48 compares full-diagnosis fine-tuning with prompted models on the frozen holdout.
sents.zh: 表 48 比较了在冻结保留集上全诊断微调模型与提示模型的表现。

sents.en: Both the unfiltered and certified-subset full-diagnosis rows have completed evaluation.
sents.zh: 未经过滤和经认证子集的全诊断行均已完成评估。

paragraphs.en: Full fine-tuning uses explanation, evidence and proposed action as the target, with attribution fields first. Frozen-protocol and budget-forced evaluations remain separate. Agreement is with recorded teacher labels; the historical human audit does not relabel this test set. Claims of superiority require a paired interval excluding zero; matching requires the predeclared two-point non-inferiority margin.
paragraphs.zh: 完整微调以解释、证据和拟议行动作为目标，其中归因字段置于首位。 冻结协议和预算强制评估仍保持独立。 一致性以记录在案的教师标签为准；历史人类审核不会重新标记此测试集。 优越性主张需要一个排除零的配对区间；匹配则需要预先声明的两点非劣效性界值。

sents.en: Full fine-tuning uses explanation, evidence and proposed action as the target, with attribution fields first.
sents.zh: 完整微调以解释、证据和拟议行动作为目标，其中归因字段置于首位。

sents.en: Frozen-protocol and budget-forced evaluations remain separate.
sents.zh: 冻结协议和预算强制评估仍保持独立。

sents.en: Agreement is with recorded teacher labels; the historical human audit does not relabel this test set.
sents.zh: 一致性以记录在案的教师标签为准；历史人类审核不会重新标记此测试集。

sents.en: Claims of superiority require a paired interval excluding zero; matching requires the predeclared two-point non-inferiority margin.
sents.zh: 优越性主张需要一个排除零的配对区间；匹配则需要预先声明的两点非劣效性界值。

paragraphs.en: The prompted rows saw the identical 943 943 prompts and decoding (temperature 0 0 where the provider accepts it, 8,192 8{,}192 -token budget, thinking as each channel allows), were never trained on AED , and each answered all 943 943 rows; an unparseable answer is a miss, parse rates run from 96.50 96.50 to 100.00 100.00 , and their family-macro is recomputed from per-item predictions over the holdout’s 56 56 families, as for the trained rows.
paragraphs.zh: 受提示的行列看到了完全相同的 943 个提示和解码（温度设为 0，在提供商接受的情况下；8,192 个标记预算；每个通道允许的思考方式），这些智能体从未在 AED 上进行过训练，并且每个智能体都回答了全部 943 行；无法解析的答案计为一次失败，解析率从 96.50% 到 100.00% 不等，而它们的家族宏则是基于保留集上 56 个家族的逐项预测重新计算的，与训练行列的处理方式相同。

paragraphs.en: Table 49 compares held-out task success from the initial state, without a debugger-supplied location. Training uses the corresponding benchmarks’ train-side tasks. The historical pilot’s success-only, preventive and reflective mixtures differ in task coverage, updates and token budget. The current post-error action-only control isolates the addition of reflection more closely: its erroneous action, feedback and corrected actions match the reflective arm. Training completion alone does not establish an evaluated policy benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 表 49 比较了在没有调试器提供位置信息的情况下，从初始状态执行保留任务的成功率。 训练过程使用相应基准测试的训练侧任务。 历史试点中仅包含成功结果的预防性与反思性混合策略在任务覆盖范围、更新和令牌预算方面存在差异。 当前的仅错误后行动的对照组能更精确地隔离反思机制的加入：其错误行动、反馈和修正后的行动与反思组一致。 仅完成训练本身并不能证明评估策略具有实际效益。

sents.en: Table 49 compares held-out task success from the initial state, without a debugger-supplied location.
sents.zh: 表 49 比较了在没有调试器提供位置信息的情况下，从初始状态执行保留任务的成功率。

sents.en: Training uses the corresponding benchmarks’ train-side tasks.
sents.zh: 训练过程使用相应基准测试的训练侧任务。

sents.en: The historical pilot’s success-only, preventive and reflective mixtures differ in task coverage, updates and token budget.
sents.zh: 历史试点中仅包含成功结果的预防性与反思性混合策略在任务覆盖范围、更新和令牌预算方面存在差异。

sents.en: The current post-error action-only control isolates the addition of reflection more closely: its erroneous action, feedback and corrected actions match the reflective arm.
sents.zh: 当前的仅错误后行动的对照组能更精确地隔离反思机制的加入：其错误行动、反馈和修正后的行动与反思组一致。

sents.en: Training completion alone does not establish an evaluated policy benefit.
sents.zh: 仅完成训练本身并不能证明评估策略具有实际效益。

paragraphs.en: The reported comparisons use separate cohorts for diagnosis production, correction replay, diagnostic learning and actor training. Their input information and evaluation units determine the conclusions each supports.
paragraphs.zh: 报告中的比较使用了独立的队列，分别用于诊断生成、校正重演、诊断学习和智能体训练。 它们的输入信息和评估单元决定了各自所支持的具体结论。

sents.en: The reported comparisons use separate cohorts for diagnosis production, correction replay, diagnostic learning and actor training.
sents.zh: 报告中的比较使用了独立的队列，分别用于诊断生成、校正重演、诊断学习和智能体训练。

sents.en: Their input information and evaluation units determine the conclusions each supports.
sents.zh: 它们的输入信息和评估单元决定了各自所支持的具体结论。

paragraphs.en: All planned evaluation cases remain in the denominator, including missing and unparseable answers, except for the explicitly identified complete-case recovery and real-environment summaries. We report their failure accounting alongside the scores. Source-task clustering addresses repeated tasks; training-seed variation measures a different source of uncertainty. First proposals and search-selected corrections retain separate paired controls.
paragraphs.zh: 所有计划中的评估案例都保留在分母中，包括缺失和无法解析的答案，但明确标识出的完整案例恢复和真实环境摘要除外。 我们在分数旁报告了它们的失败情况。 源任务聚类处理重复任务；训练种子变化则衡量另一种不确定性来源。 初始提议和搜索选定的修正保留了独立的配对对照。

sents.en: All planned evaluation cases remain in the denominator, including missing and unparseable answers, except for the explicitly identified complete-case recovery and real-environment summaries.
sents.zh: 所有计划中的评估案例都保留在分母中，包括缺失和无法解析的答案，但明确标识出的完整案例恢复和真实环境摘要除外。

sents.en: We report their failure accounting alongside the scores.
sents.zh: 我们在分数旁报告了它们的失败情况。

sents.en: Source-task clustering addresses repeated tasks; training-seed variation measures a different source of uncertainty.
sents.zh: 源任务聚类处理重复任务；训练种子变化则衡量另一种不确定性来源。

sents.en: First proposals and search-selected corrections retain separate paired controls.
sents.zh: 初始提议和搜索选定的修正保留了独立的配对对照。

paragraphs.en: We found no exact overlap in task identities, task content, complete traces or the audited trajectory prefixes. The internal holdout shares environments with training, and most examples also share the harness and policy; it measures within-distribution generalization. We also checked similar input text and repeated user goals across task variants. In both checks, the gain from the larger training set occurs outside the flagged subsets, whose estimated gains are zero or negative and whose intervals include zero. These checks do not rule out other forms of train–test similarity. The audit records retain the matching rules, subgroup scores and uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在任务身份、任务内容、完整轨迹或经过审计的轨迹前缀中均未发现完全重叠的情况。 内部保留集与训练集共享环境，且大多数示例也共享执行框架和策略；它衡量的是分布内泛化能力。 我们还检查了不同任务变体中相似的输入文本以及重复的用户目标。 在这两项检查中，较大训练集带来的增益均出现在被标记的子集之外，而这些子集的估计增益为零或负值，且其置信区间包含零。 这些检查并未排除其他形式的训练集与测试集之间的相似性。 审计记录保留了匹配规则、子组得分以及不确定性信息。

sents.en: We found no exact overlap in task identities, task content, complete traces or the audited trajectory prefixes.
sents.zh: 我们在任务身份、任务内容、完整轨迹或经过审计的轨迹前缀中均未发现完全重叠的情况。

sents.en: The internal holdout shares environments with training, and most examples also share the harness and policy; it measures within-distribution generalization.
sents.zh: 内部保留集与训练集共享环境，且大多数示例也共享执行框架和策略；它衡量的是分布内泛化能力。

sents.en: We also checked similar input text and repeated user goals across task variants.
sents.zh: 我们还检查了不同任务变体中相似的输入文本以及重复的用户目标。

sents.en: In both checks, the gain from the larger training set occurs outside the flagged subsets, whose estimated gains are zero or negative and whose intervals include zero.
sents.zh: 在这两项检查中，较大训练集带来的增益均出现在被标记的子集之外，而这些子集的估计增益为零或负值，且其置信区间包含零。

sents.en: These checks do not rule out other forms of train–test similarity.
sents.zh: 这些检查并未排除其他形式的训练集与测试集之间的相似性。

sents.en: The audit records retain the matching rules, subgroup scores and uncertainty.
sents.zh: 审计记录保留了匹配规则、子组得分以及不确定性信息。

paragraphs.en: The recipes differ in task coverage, per-environment exposure and optimizer updates. Their contrasts describe the combined recipes and do not isolate the effect of repair supervision. Post-error action-only and reflective arms share erroneous actions, observed feedback and corrected continuations; reflection also changes the context for later actions and the supervised-token budget. A state-changing error requires a continuation executed from that post-error state; a passing pre-error branch cannot be spliced after it.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方案在任务覆盖范围、每个环境的暴露程度以及优化器更新方面存在差异。 它们之间的对比描述了组合后的方案，并未单独区分修复监督所产生的影响。 “仅执行错误后动作”分支与“反思型”分支共享错误的动作、观察到的反馈以及修正后的后续操作；而反思过程还会改变后续动作的上下文环境以及受监督的令牌预算。 状态变更类错误需要从一个错误发生后的状态开始执行后续操作；而一个未触发的错误前分支无法在该状态之后被拼接进来。

sents.en: The recipes differ in task coverage, per-environment exposure and optimizer updates.
sents.zh: 这些方案在任务覆盖范围、每个环境的暴露程度以及优化器更新方面存在差异。

sents.en: Their contrasts describe the combined recipes and do not isolate the effect of repair supervision.
sents.zh: 它们之间的对比描述了组合后的方案，并未单独区分修复监督所产生的影响。

sents.en: Post-error action-only and reflective arms share erroneous actions, observed feedback and corrected continuations; reflection also changes the context for later actions and the supervised-token budget.
sents.zh: “仅执行错误后动作”分支与“反思型”分支共享错误的动作、观察到的反馈以及修正后的后续操作；而反思过程还会改变后续动作的上下文环境以及受监督的令牌预算。

sents.en: A state-changing error requires a continuation executed from that post-error state; a passing pre-error branch cannot be spliced after it.
sents.zh: 状态变更类错误需要从一个错误发生后的状态开始执行后续操作；而一个未触发的错误前分支无法在该状态之后被拼接进来。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis production measures yield under the stated output requirements and teacher access. Agreement with a construction teacher and admission yield do not establish human-assessed label correctness. The prepared human audit assesses individual records under shared AI assistance, not blinded paired outputs from different construction methods. Its coverage-selected sample does not estimate collection-wide accuracy. The historical student comparisons also vary teacher access or target construction, so their contrasts do not isolate pipeline quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在规定的输出要求和教师可及性条件下，诊断生成措施会产生相应的结果。 与建筑教师的协议以及录取结果并不能确立由人类评估的标签正确性。 准备就绪的人工审计会在共享人工智能辅助下评估单个记录，而非来自不同构建方法的盲测配对输出。 其按覆盖范围选择的样本无法估算整个收集集的准确性。 历史学生之间的比较也因教师可及性或目标构建方式的不同而存在差异，因此它们的对比无法单独反映流程质量。

sents.en: Diagnosis production measures yield under the stated output requirements and teacher access.
sents.zh: 在规定的输出要求和教师可及性条件下，诊断生成措施会产生相应的结果。

sents.en: Agreement with a construction teacher and admission yield do not establish human-assessed label correctness.
sents.zh: 与建筑教师的协议以及录取结果并不能确立由人类评估的标签正确性。

sents.en: The prepared human audit assesses individual records under shared AI assistance, not blinded paired outputs from different construction methods.
sents.zh: 准备就绪的人工审计会在共享人工智能辅助下评估单个记录，而非来自不同构建方法的盲测配对输出。

sents.en: Its coverage-selected sample does not estimate collection-wide accuracy.
sents.zh: 其按覆盖范围选择的样本无法估算整个收集集的准确性。

sents.en: The historical student comparisons also vary teacher access or target construction, so their contrasts do not isolate pipeline quality.
sents.zh: 历史学生之间的比较也因教师可及性或目标构建方式的不同而存在差异，因此它们的对比无法单独反映流程质量。

paragraphs.en: Within each reported protocol, comparisons share frozen cases, input information and scoring rules. First-call and budget-forced evaluations remain separate. Who&When’s responsible agent, AgentErrorBench’s module and TrajErrBench’s error mode are distinct labels. Published native-protocol scores provide context outside the shared-prompt tables. The AgenTracer-data comparison uses a common student recipe and compares training resources, not the original AgenTracer algorithm. These comparisons support protocol-specific conclusions rather than a public leaderboard ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 在每份已报告的协议中，比较都共享了固定案例、输入信息和评分规则。 首次调用评估与预算强制评估仍然相互独立。 “谁与何时”的责任智能体、AgentErrorBench 的模块以及 TrajErrBench 的错误模式均为独立的标签。 已发布的原生协议分数为共享提示词表之外的情况提供了背景信息。 AgenTracer 数据的比较使用了一套通用的学生方案，并比较了训练资源，而非原始的 AgenTracer 算法。 这些比较支持针对特定协议的结论，而非用于公共排行榜的排名。

sents.en: Within each reported protocol, comparisons share frozen cases, input information and scoring rules.
sents.zh: 在每份已报告的协议中，比较都共享了固定案例、输入信息和评分规则。

sents.en: First-call and budget-forced evaluations remain separate.
sents.zh: 首次调用评估与预算强制评估仍然相互独立。

sents.en: Who&When’s responsible agent, AgentErrorBench’s module and TrajErrBench’s error mode are distinct labels.
sents.zh: “谁与何时”的责任智能体、AgentErrorBench 的模块以及 TrajErrBench 的错误模式均为独立的标签。

sents.en: Published native-protocol scores provide context outside the shared-prompt tables.
sents.zh: 已发布的原生协议分数为共享提示词表之外的情况提供了背景信息。

sents.en: The AgenTracer-data comparison uses a common student recipe and compares training resources, not the original AgenTracer algorithm.
sents.zh: AgenTracer 数据的比较使用了一套通用的学生方案，并比较了训练资源，而非原始的 AgenTracer 算法。

sents.en: These comparisons support protocol-specific conclusions rather than a public leaderboard ranking.
sents.zh: 这些比较支持针对特定协议的结论，而非用于公共排行榜的排名。

paragraphs.en: The common failure pool covers 1,068 1{,}068 source tasks, 16 16 environments, 10 10 harness families and 15 15 policy models. It excludes evaluation-exposed tasks and caps contributions per task. Every configuration receives the same failed executions. Table 19 includes abstentions, malformed diagnoses and engine errors in the input denominator. The main table shows representative single-pass, deep-analysis, multi-model and citation-first configurations; the full comparison is below.
paragraphs.zh: 通用故障池涵盖 1,068 个源任务、16 个环境、10 个测试框架家族和 15 个策略模型。 它不包括评估中暴露的任务，并对每个任务的贡献设置了上限。 每种配置都会收到相同的失败执行记录。 表 19 在输入分母中包含了弃权、格式错误的诊断以及引擎错误。 主表展示了具有代表性的单次通过、深度分析、多模型和优先引用等配置；完整的比较见下文。

sents.zh: 通用故障池涵盖 1,068 个源任务、16 个环境、10 个测试框架家族和 15 个策略模型。

sents.en: It excludes evaluation-exposed tasks and caps contributions per task.
sents.zh: 它不包括评估中暴露的任务，并对每个任务的贡献设置了上限。

paragraphs.en: Single-model configurations use GPT-5-mini. Consensus uses GPT-5-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash voters, with Gemini as arbiter. Each engine keeps its production renderer and decoding defaults. Success-reference methods additionally use available same-task successful traces. Task reference answers and verifier signals are withheld; historical inputs also omit the policy’s system prompt. AgentDebugX adapters invoke its diagnosis implementations ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) ; deep analysis omits the separate taxonomy-generalization call. Thus neither the teacher ensemble nor rendering is controlled across all rows.
paragraphs.zh: 单模型配置使用 GPT-5-mini。 共识机制使用 GPT-5-mini、Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Gemini 3.6 Flash 作为投票者，并由 Gemini 担任仲裁者。 每个引擎都保留其生产渲染器和默认解码设置。 成功参考方法还会使用可用的同一任务的成功轨迹。 任务参考答案和验证器信号均被保留；历史输入也省略了策略的系统提示。 AgentDebugX 适配器会调用其诊断实现（Zhu 等人，2026）；深度分析则省略了独立的分类泛化调用。 因此，在所有行中，既没有教师集成模型，也没有渲染过程受到控制。

paragraphs.en: Costs use whole-job diagnosis meters divided by every input, including failed calls. They exclude trajectory generation, correction replay and hosting. Pair yield requires a structured location and a matched citation under the historical export rule; a matching quote does not establish a correct attribution or a supported correction. Methods that do not emit that citation format can have low yield without being poor localizers. The comparison supports choosing an export-compatible production route, not a claim of superior diagnosis quality.
paragraphs.zh: 成本计算使用整个任务的诊断仪表除以所有输入，包括失败的调用。 它们不包括轨迹生成、修正重播和托管服务。 配对产出需要符合历史导出规则的结构化位置与匹配引用；仅凭匹配的引文无法确立正确的归属或有效的修正。 不输出该引用格式的方法可能产出率较低，但这并不意味着其定位能力差。 这种比较有助于选择兼容导出流程的生产路线，而非声称诊断质量更优。

paragraphs.en: For a cohort with a fixed acceptance rule, cost per retained record is total construction spend divided by retained records, including spend on rejected candidates. Rollout, diagnosis, review and optional replay have separate meters; hosting and human labor require additional accounting. The studies below cover different cohorts and must not be added into a full-collection bill. USD values use recorded token usage and the configured channel prices, not independently reconciled invoices. The collection waves use GPT-5.6-Sol with the all-at-once diagnosis engine; their policy and task mixtures differ. Semantic-review and selected-row cost estimates for a separate pool appear in Table 50 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于采用固定接受规则的群体，每份保留记录的成本等于总建设支出除以保留记录数，其中包含被拒绝候选人的支出。 部署、诊断、审查和可选重播各自有独立的计量器；托管和人力成本需要额外核算。 以下研究涉及不同的群体，不得将其费用合并到完整集合的账单中。 美元金额基于记录的令牌使用量和配置好的通道价格计算，而非独立对账的发票。 这些收集波次使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 和一次性诊断引擎；其策略和任务组合各不相同。 单独池中的语义审查和选中行成本估算见第 50 表。

paragraphs.en: The cost of obtaining a failure depends on policy success, trace length and tool interaction; the cost of retaining a pair also depends on the acceptance rule. Completing diagnosis does not guarantee a trace-supported or semantically accepted target. These tables therefore do not price the final quality-admitted release. Stopped cells have settled meters but no completed collection protocol; unsettled meters may omit outstanding calls. We show their logged spend separately instead of treating either group as zero-cost output.

paragraphs.en: The admission ablation fixes source tasks, teacher inputs and candidate diagnoses. Grounding requires all 56 56 deterministic hard flags; semantic review adds acceptance by both judges on the same input. The nested pool excludes 29 29 of the 796 796 rows in the released certified pool because they fail the current flag record. Yield counts candidate rows; tasks and environments count distinct retained sources outside the held-out packs. Total cost per retained row must include generation, checking and rejected candidates. Table 50 reports this accounting as an estimate: matched spend plus extrapolation for unmatched records, with joined-only values reported separately. It is not the diagnosis-only production cost in Table 47 . The measured semantic-review stage costs USD 0.039 0.039 per Claude Opus 5 verdict on a 200 200 -verdict calibration sample; human-review cost is separate. The proposed matched-pool human audit uses random samples and inclusion weights. The existing purposive coverage audit cannot supply those estimates.

paragraphs.en: Relative to the base, the 948 948 -task fine-tune loses up to − 29.37 -29.37 pp under the training-format prompt and up to − 9.52 -9.52 pp under Who&When’s source prompt (Table 30 ). Mixed-format continuation on the same 948 948 tasks raises Who&When AG, WG from 9.52 % 9.52\% to 34.13 % 34.13\% (base 38.89 % 38.89\% ) under the training-format prompt. After this continuation, the seven-field holdout changes little ( 58.43 % 58.43\% versus 58.64 % 58.64\% ), but TrajErrBench does not recover. Continuation changes training as well as format exposure, so this recovery does not isolate a format-only effect. On the internal holdout, the responsible-agent label is constant over 943 943 cases: the base’s 41.15 41.15 unit + + step versus 47.19 47.19 exact step reflects its tendency to name other units. We omit that joint metric from the main comparison.

paragraphs.en: The frozen training pool includes all six evaluation environments. The pool manifest records task-identity and payload-overlap checks for the held-out tasks; this design tests task generalization within the same environment set. These environments are excluded from the released core corpus and form a separate development pool. The baseline pins its model revision; full fine-tunes require checkpoint directories and training manifests. The action-only and reflective arms share erroneous actions, feedback and corrected continuations. A state-changing failure requires a continuation executed from that post-error state; a passing pre-error branch cannot be substituted. Success-only trajectories may themselves contain recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的训练池包含全部六个评估环境。 该训练池清单记录了预留任务的任务身份和负载重叠检查；这种设计用于测试在同一环境集合内的任务泛化能力。 这些环境被排除在已发布的核心语料库之外，并构成一个独立的开发池。 基线模型固定了其模型版本；完整的微调需要检查点目录和训练清单。 仅动作分支和反思性分支共享错误动作、反馈以及修正后的后续步骤。 状态变化的失败需要从那之后错误状态开始执行的后续步骤；通过前错误分支的分支不能替代它。 仅成功的轨迹本身可能包含恢复过程。

sents.zh: 冻结的训练池包含全部六个评估环境。

sents.zh: 基线模型固定了其模型版本；完整的微调需要检查点目录和训练清单。

sents.en: The action-only and reflective arms share erroneous actions, feedback and corrected continuations.
sents.zh: 仅动作分支和反思性分支共享错误动作、反馈以及修正后的后续步骤。

sents.en: A state-changing failure requires a continuation executed from that post-error state; a passing pre-error branch cannot be substituted.

paragraphs.en: Only Text-to-SQL syntax is touched by the parser change in this comparison. Two additional strict-parser baseline runs succeed on 5 5 – 7 7 text-to-SQL and 7 7 – 13 13 WebShop-lite tasks in the fixed subset. ALFWorld-lite, TextQuest, Warehouse and Gridworld have 1 1 , 3 3 , 90 90 and 0 0 subset tasks, respectively, against untrained success of 88.0 88.0 , 67.7 67.7 , 2.0 2.0 and 5.0 5.0 . Gridworld’s zero reflects the frozen scorer’s coverage: every one of its 100 100 episodes includes a refusal ( 409 409 records, 295 295 blocked ) whose code lies outside the scorer’s event tables. The earlier full-environment pilot is unusable for the headline comparison: no ALFWorld failure meets the corpus terminal-shape proxy, and ScienceWorld returned run errors on 47 47 of 54 54 episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 在此比较中，解析器的更改仅影响了文本转 SQL 语法。 在固定子集中，两个额外的严格解析器基线运行在 5 5 – 7 7 个文本转 SQL 任务和 7 7 – 13 13 个 WebShop-lite 任务上取得成功。 这些结果并未估计在修正后的解析器或常见错误后恢复状态下的运行间变异性。 ALFWorld-lite、TextQuest、Warehouse 和 Gridworld 分别有 1 1 、3 3 、90 90 和 0 0 个子集任务，而未训练的成功率分别为 88.0 、67.7 、2.0 和 5.0 。 Gridworld 的零值反映了冻结评分器的覆盖范围：其 100 个回合中的每一个都包含一次拒绝（409 条记录，295 次被阻止），其代码位于评分器的事件表之外。 早期的完整环境试点无法用于主要比较：没有任何 ALFWorld 失败情况符合语料库终端形态代理，而 ScienceWorld 在 54 个回合中有 47 个返回了运行错误。

paragraphs.en: The public benchmarks measure agreement with a recorded error step, conditional on failure; a match does not establish a unique root cause. Under one evaluation run over four public splits (Table 26 ), both trained arms stay close to the base on three and score lower on AgentErrorBench — descriptive differences that establish no consistent transfer benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 公开基准测试衡量的是在发生故障的前提下，与记录的错误步骤的一致性；匹配结果并不能确定唯一的根本原因。 在一次评估中，针对四个公开数据集划分（表 26），两种训练模型在三个数据集上的表现均接近基线模型，但在 AgentErrorBench 上的得分较低——这些描述性差异并未表明存在一致的迁移优势。

paragraphs.en: Table 30 runs thirteen paired tests and prints each p p without correction. Holm over that declared family of thirteen leaves three cells significant, all of them losses and all in the training-format prompt family (Table 31 ); the positive unified Who&When cell does not survive (Holm 0.437 0.437 ). Twelve of the thirteen reported conditions decoded their arm on a different machine from their base, so we re-decoded the same published checkpoint on the same instance as the base and paired predictions case by case. The arm reproduces its reported value in all thirteen cells, moving at most 0.24 0.24 of the decode floor’s standard deviation and never more than two, against a pooled flip rate of q = 0.1433 q=0.1433 measured by re-decoding one model twice on one machine. That pooled rate comes from two cells. A third cell re-decoded on the same instance flips only 5.00 % 5.00\% of its items, three times less often, so the floor is a property of the cell as much as of the decode. The tighter rate is the demanding one here, because a smaller q q shrinks the standard deviation the shifts are divided by: under it the largest shift is 0.40 0.40 of a standard deviation and no cell passes two. Holm correction after the repeat evaluation retains the same three losses.
paragraphs.zh: 表30运行了十三项配对测试，并直接打印了每个p值，未经校正。 Holm校正针对上述十三项测试所构成的族检验，仅保留三个单元为显著结果，且均为负向结果，全部出现在训练格式提示词族中（表31）；而正向统一“Who&When”单元未能通过检验（Holm 0.437 0.437）。 在报告条件的十三项测试中，有十二项是在与基础模型不同的机器上对其分支进行解码的，因此我们对同一已发布的检查点在相同实例上进行了重新解码，并对预测结果逐项进行配对比较。 该分支在所有十三项测试中均复现了其报告值，与解码基线的标准偏差相比最多仅偏移0.24 0.24，且从未超过两个标准偏差；而通过在一台机器上对同一模型进行两次重新解码测得的合并翻转率为q = 0.1433 q=0.1433。 该合并率来自两个单元。 第三个单元在相同实例上重新解码时，仅有5.00 % 5.00\%的项目发生翻转，频率低三倍，因此这一基线既是解码过程的结果，也是该单元的特性。 此处更严格的翻转率更具挑战性，因为较小的q值会缩小偏移量所除以的标准偏差：在此条件下，最大偏移量为标准偏差的0.40，且没有单元超过两个标准偏差。 重复评估后的Holm校正仍保留相同的三个负向结果。

paragraphs.en: All three surviving cells also lose answer-contract compliance. A contract failure scores as a miss, so we report a descriptive sensitivity on cases both arms parsed. The two Who&When AG cells reverse sign, to + 4.08 +4.08 ( n = 49 n=49 , p = 0.79 p=0.79 ) and + 13.04 +13.04 ( n = 23 n=23 , p = 0.51 p=0.51 ), with neither reaching nominal significance. TrajErrBench keeps − 11.73 -11.73 on the 452 452 cases both arms parsed ( p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ) against 7.00 7.00 points of contract loss. Thus, the TrajErrBench regression persists within parseable outputs. The restriction selects on a post-treatment variable: it cannot attribute the full-cohort loss to formatting or diagnosis, nor establish that diagnosis quality is unchanged in the AG cells. We retain the full-cohort tests as primary and treat this subset analysis as descriptive, outside the family of independent confirmatory tests.

paragraphs.en: The recovery numbers elsewhere hold the told step fixed at the corpus’s own label, so they cannot separate “the localizer found the right place” from “this actor recovers from anywhere”. We varied only the told step. On the frozen 150 150 -failure cohort, with GPT-5 mini proposing one replacement action and a fixed actor continuing, three arms differ in nothing but where the proposer is told the error is: our labelled step, a step drawn uniformly from the same trajectory among those that are neither the labelled one nor the last, and no step at all, the proposer deciding for itself. Moving the told step moves the restored checkpoint, so each arm is scored against its own sham control drawn from its own checkpoint; rates across arms are not comparable and the within-arm contrast is the one to read.
paragraphs.zh: 其他地方的恢复数值将“告知步骤”固定为语料库自身的标签，因此它们无法区分“定位器找到了正确位置”和“该智能体从任何地方恢复”。 我们仅改变了“告知步骤”。 在冻结的 150×150 失败队列中，GPT-5 mini 提出一个替换动作，而固定智能体则持续执行；三个分支仅在“告知提案者错误所在”这一点上有所不同：我们的标签步骤、从同一轨迹中均匀抽取且既非标签步骤也非最后一步的步骤，以及完全不指定步骤，由提案者自行决定。 移动“告知步骤”会改变恢复的检查点，因此每个分支都基于其自身检查点抽取的虚拟对照进行评分；各分支之间的比率不可比较，应关注的是分支内部的对比。

sents.en: On the frozen 150 150 -failure cohort, with GPT-5 mini proposing one replacement action and a fixed actor continuing, three arms differ in nothing but where the proposer is told the error is: our labelled step, a step drawn uniformly from the same trajectory among those that are neither the labelled one nor the last, and no step at all, the proposer deciding for itself.
sents.zh: 在冻结的 150×150 失败队列中，GPT-5 mini 提出一个替换动作，而固定智能体则持续执行；三个分支仅在“告知提案者错误所在”这一点上有所不同：我们的标签步骤、从同一轨迹中均匀抽取且既非标签步骤也非最后一步的步骤，以及完全不指定步骤，由提案者自行决定。

paragraphs.en: Told our step, the proposal beats its control by 12.9 12.9 points ( 26 26 proposal-only against 7 7 control-only over 147 147 paired rows, p = 1.3 × 10 − 3 p=1.3\times 10^{-3} ). Told a different step, the same proposer and actor gain 3.1 3.1 points ( 18 18 against 14 14 over 129 129 rows, p = 0.60 p=0.60 ): this within-arm comparison does not establish that the labelled location is better than the alternative location. Told nothing, the proposer names a replayable step on 136 136 of 150 150 rows, agrees with our label on 90 90 , and gains 9.8 9.8 points ( 20 20 against 7 7 over 133 133 rows, p = 1.9 × 10 − 2 p=1.9\times 10^{-2} ). Between our label and the un-cued proposer the difference is not significant on the 144 144 rows where both ran ( p = 0.41 p=0.41 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在告知我们步骤的情况下，该提案比对照方案高出 12.9 分（在 147 行配对数据中，仅提案组得分为 26，仅对照组得分为 7，p = 1.3 × 10⁻³）。 在告知不同步骤的情况下，同一提案者和执行者获得了 3.1 分（在 129 行数据中，得分为 18 对比 14，p = 0.60）：这种组内比较无法证明所标记的位置优于替代位置。 在未告知任何信息的情况下，提案者在 150 行数据中的 136 行选择了可重播的步骤，在 90 行中与我们标记的选项一致，并获得了 9.8 分（在 133 行数据中，得分为 20 对比 7，p = 1.9 × 10⁻²）。 在我们标记的选项与未受提示的提案者之间，在两者均参与运行的 144 行数据中，差异并不显著（p = 0.41）。

paragraphs.en: Two caveats bound this. The cohort overlaps training — 55 55 of its 150 150 tasks are in the train slice — so these are exploratory numbers, not a held-out claim. And a null between arms at this size is not equivalence. The labelled arm’s prompts are byte-identical to the frozen T2 pack on all 150 150 rows and reproduce that pilot’s direction and significance under a stochastic k = 1 k{=}1 continuation. The prompts passed the information-access check; recorded cost was $ 3.66 3.66 .
paragraphs.zh: 两点注意事项对此构成了限制。 该队列与训练集存在重叠——其 150 个任务中有 55 个属于训练部分——因此这些只是探索性数据，而非独立验证的结果。 在此规模下，组间无差异并不等同于等效性。 标记组的提示词在所有 150 行上与冻结的 T2 包完全一致，并在随机 k = 1 的延续下重现了该试点的方向和显著性。 提示词通过了信息访问检查；记录的成本为 $3.66。

paragraphs.en: On trajectories where the production debugger declined, an explicit schema instruction did not improve citation-grounded admission over retrying the unchanged prompt. Removing the option to abstain did not support the proposed abstention mechanism either. Repeated identical calls also changed admission outcomes, limiting single-call comparisons. A separate successful-output stratum showed a nominal adverse grounding result, which did not survive the stated multiplicity threshold. These development studies do not justify either prompt change; their registrations and complete results remain in the archive.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成调试器表现不佳的轨迹中，明确的模式指令并未使基于引用的接纳率优于重复使用未修改的提示。 移除弃权选项同样未能支持所提出的弃权机制。 重复调用相同的提示也改变了接纳结果，从而限制了单次调用的比较。 一个独立的成功输出层级显示出名义上的负面基础结果，但该结果未能通过规定的多重性阈值。 这些开发研究并未证明任何提示变更的合理性；其注册信息和完整结果仍保留在存档中。

paragraphs.en: Earlier development packages and the rollout atlas have different eligibility rules and do not define the frozen release. New production is counted as distinct source-task and trace identifiers, followed separately by attempted diagnoses, grounded candidates, and validated replay products. Multiple policies, harnesses, temperatures, or judges do not create new source tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的开发包和发布路线图具有不同的资格规则，且未定义冻结版本。 新的生产流程会被计为独立的源任务与追踪标识符，随后会分别记录尝试的诊断、已确定的候选项以及经过验证的重播产物。 多个策略、框架、温度值或评判器并不会创建新的源任务。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis can use environments with a documented scoring rule even when replay is unavailable. The current diagnosis queue disables certification for GAIA, Mind2Web (static), and WideSearch; a deterministic static observation witness alone does not establish a valid interactive repair endpoint. Missing verifier outcomes, infrastructure errors, and deliberately omitted replay are distinct statuses. No certificate is inferred from attribution presence or a successful serialization. The current k = 1 k=1 production setting can supply a single-pair contrast, but cannot satisfy the replicated certificate threshold of at least two executions per arm.
paragraphs.zh: 即使无法重播，诊断也可以使用具有明确评分规则的环境。 当前的诊断队列禁用了 GAIA、Mind2Web（静态）和 WideSearch 的认证；仅凭一个确定性的静态观察见证无法确立有效的交互式修复终点。 验证器结果缺失、基础设施错误以及故意省略重播是三种不同的状态。 不能根据归属信息的存在或序列化成功来推断出任何证书。 当前的 k = 1 k=1 生产设置可以提供单对对比，但无法满足每个分支至少两次执行的复制证书阈值。

paragraphs.en: Fifteen environments are targeted: ALFWorld, AppWorld, AgentBench-DB, AgentBench-OS, BFCL, GAIA, MCPMark, Mind2Web (static), ScienceWorld, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-smith, τ \tau -bench airline, τ \tau -bench retail, Terminal-Bench, and WideSearch. The frozen-release collection plan repeated each environment’s tasks across policy, harness, and temperature rather than one rollout per task, because several of these pools are small (e.g. 26 26 τ \tau -bench airline train tasks, 31 31 MCPMark); nine harnesses were available (three built-in, six external), and a failure that appears only under one harness or one temperature is a different observation, not padding.
paragraphs.zh: 本次研究针对十五个环境：ALFWorld、AppWorld、AgentBench-DB、AgentBench-OS、BFCL、GAIA、MCPMark、Mind2Web（静态）、ScienceWorld、SWE-bench Verified、SWE-smith、τ \tau -bench airline、τ \tau -bench retail、Terminal-Bench 和 WideSearch。 在冻结发布收集计划中，每个环境的任务都通过策略、框架和温度参数重复执行，而非每个任务仅运行一次，因为这些测试池中的部分任务数量较少（例如，τ \tau -bench airline 有 26 个训练任务，MCPMark 有 31 个）；共有九个可用框架（三个内置框架和六个外部框架），且仅在某个特定框架或温度下出现的故障属于不同的观察结果，而非填充数据。

sents.zh: 本次研究针对十五个环境：ALFWorld、AppWorld、AgentBench-DB、AgentBench-OS、BFCL、GAIA、MCPMark、Mind2Web（静态）、ScienceWorld、SWE-bench Verified、SWE-smith、τ \tau -bench airline、τ \tau -bench retail、Terminal-Bench 和 WideSearch。

sents.en: The frozen-release collection plan repeated each environment’s tasks across policy, harness, and temperature rather than one rollout per task, because several of these pools are small (e.g. 26 26 τ \tau -bench airline train tasks, 31 31 MCPMark); nine harnesses were available (three built-in, six external), and a failure that appears only under one harness or one temperature is a different observation, not padding.
sents.zh: 在冻结发布收集计划中，每个环境的任务都通过策略、框架和温度参数重复执行，而非每个任务仅运行一次，因为这些测试池中的部分任务数量较少（例如，τ \tau -bench airline 有 26 个训练任务，MCPMark 有 31 个）；共有九个可用框架（三个内置框架和六个外部框架），且仅在某个特定框架或温度下出现的故障属于不同的观察结果，而非填充数据。

paragraphs.en: The replay budget analysis derived the per-arm sample count from the measured pass-rate variance and cost of each environment; the analysis, its result table and the alternatives it rejected are in the repository archive. Table 37 records the state-restoration checks that decided which environments can replay at all. The current construction uses one execution per arm and reports the paired discordant counts directly (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 重播预算分析根据测得的通过率方差以及每个环境的成本，推导出每个智能体的样本数量；该分析、其结果表以及被拒绝的替代方案均存储于仓库存档中。 表 37 记录了状态恢复检查，这些检查决定了哪些环境可以执行重播。 当前的构建方案为每个智能体使用一次执行，并直接报告成对的矛盾计数（第 5 节）。

sents.en: The replay budget analysis derived the per-arm sample count from the measured pass-rate variance and cost of each environment; the analysis, its result table and the alternatives it rejected are in the repository archive.
sents.zh: 重播预算分析根据测得的通过率方差以及每个环境的成本，推导出每个智能体的样本数量；该分析、其结果表以及被拒绝的替代方案均存储于仓库存档中。

sents.en: Table 37 records the state-restoration checks that decided which environments can replay at all.
sents.zh: 表 37 记录了状态恢复检查，这些检查决定了哪些环境可以执行重播。

sents.en: The current construction uses one execution per arm and reports the paired discordant counts directly (Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 当前的构建方案为每个智能体使用一次执行，并直接报告成对的矛盾计数（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: We screen candidate splits against prior model evaluations before using them for confirmatory comparisons. Exposure is assessed from recorded outputs, including partial runs, and is distinct from ordinary rollout collection or teacher annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 在将候选分割用于确认性比较之前，我们会根据先前的模型评估结果对其进行筛选。 暴露度通过记录的输出进行评估，包括部分运行结果，这与普通的部署收集或教师标注有所不同。

sents.en: We screen candidate splits against prior model evaluations before using them for confirmatory comparisons.
sents.zh: 在将候选分割用于确认性比较之前，我们会根据先前的模型评估结果对其进行筛选。

sents.en: Exposure is assessed from recorded outputs, including partial runs, and is distinct from ordinary rollout collection or teacher annotation.
sents.zh: 暴露度通过记录的输出进行评估，包括部分运行结果，这与普通的部署收集或教师标注有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The exposure registry resolves prior evaluation outputs, including partial runs, to source tasks, trajectories and leakage components. Construction-time teacher labels and unexecuted prompts do not count as evaluation exposure. Public benchmark identifiers remain in a separate registry. Undocumented external use cannot be ruled out.
paragraphs.zh: 暴露注册表将先前的评估输出（包括部分运行）追溯至任务、轨迹和泄露组件。 构建时的教师标签和未执行的提示不计为评估暴露。 公开基准标识符保留在独立的注册表中。 无法排除未经文档记录的外部使用。

sents.en: The exposure registry resolves prior evaluation outputs, including partial runs, to source tasks, trajectories and leakage components.
sents.zh: 暴露注册表将先前的评估输出（包括部分运行）追溯至任务、轨迹和泄露组件。

sents.en: Construction-time teacher labels and unexecuted prompts do not count as evaluation exposure.
sents.zh: 构建时的教师标签和未执行的提示不计为评估暴露。

sents.en: Public benchmark identifiers remain in a separate registry.
sents.zh: 公开基准标识符保留在独立的注册表中。

sents.en: Undocumented external use cannot be ruled out.
sents.zh: 无法排除未经文档记录的外部使用。

paragraphs.en: We withdrew the earlier v12r split’s confirmatory designation after detecting prior exposure. The v13 pilot uses an ingestion cutoff committed before scoring, an immutable input snapshot and component-level exclusion. Its eligible train, development and holdout partitions had no recorded exposure under that registry; previously exposed components form a separate exploratory split.
paragraphs.zh: 在检测到先前暴露后，我们撤销了早期 v12r 拆分中的确认性指定。 v13 试点采用在评分前确定的摄入截止点、不可更改的输入快照以及组件级排除方法。 其符合条件的训练、开发和保留分区在该注册表下没有记录任何暴露；先前暴露的组件构成一个独立的探索性拆分。

sents.en: We withdrew the earlier v12r split’s confirmatory designation after detecting prior exposure.
sents.zh: 在检测到先前暴露后，我们撤销了早期 v12r 拆分中的确认性指定。

sents.en: The v13 pilot uses an ingestion cutoff committed before scoring, an immutable input snapshot and component-level exclusion.
sents.zh: v13 试点采用在评分前确定的摄入截止点、不可更改的输入快照以及组件级排除方法。

sents.en: Its eligible train, development and holdout partitions had no recorded exposure under that registry; previously exposed components form a separate exploratory split.
sents.zh: 其符合条件的训练、开发和保留分区在该注册表下没有记录任何暴露；先前暴露的组件构成一个独立的探索性拆分。

paragraphs.en: The v14 release applies the same salt and component rule: exposed or quarantined material must not reach train, development or holdout. It places 418 418 rows over 121 121 tasks in the exploratory split. A category covering more than a quarter of an environment’s tasks is split into task-level singletons; this prevents a coarse family name from linking an entire environment, but limits family-disjointness claims. No separate v14 audit against the exposure registry was run. The evidence is the export rule, not an independent measurement of zero exposure.
paragraphs.zh: v14 版本应用了相同的盐和组件规则：暴露或隔离的材料不得进入训练、开发或保留集。 它在探索性划分中，将 418 行分配给 121 个任务。 一个涵盖环境中超过四分之一任务的类别被拆分为任务级的独立单元；这防止了一个宽泛的家族名称将整个环境关联起来，但也限制了对家族不交性的主张。 未针对暴露注册表运行独立的 v14 审计。 证据是导出规则，而非对零暴露的独立测量。

sents.en: The evidence is the export rule, not an independent measurement of zero exposure.
sents.zh: 证据是导出规则，而非对零暴露的独立测量。

paragraphs.en: Rendering and clipping remain versioned. Comparing diagnosis inputs with the policy’s recorded contract is necessary even when a quotation resolves.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染和裁剪仍然保留版本区分。 即使报价已解决，也需要将诊断输入与策略中记录的合同进行比较。

sents.zh: 渲染和裁剪仍然保留版本区分。

paragraphs.en: Matched treatment and control must share the restored state and continuation policy. This does not ensure that either reproduces the source system. Table 14 stratifies the current paired cohort by source-harness replay, substituted continuation and incomplete restoration. A contrast under substituted ReAct measures that loop; transfer to the original coordination, memory and stopping rules remains untested. Current contrasts use one sample per arm. Repeated branch outcomes and unique causation require additional evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配的治疗组与对照组必须共享恢复后的状态和延续策略。 但这并不能保证其中任何一方能够重现源系统。 表 14 根据源系统-执行器重演、替换的延续策略以及不完整的恢复情况，对当前的配对队列进行了分层分析。 在替换的 ReAct 框架下进行的对比衡量了循环过程；但向原始协调机制、记忆和停止规则的转移尚未得到验证。 当前的对比分析每组仅使用一个样本。 重复出现的分支结果和独特的因果关系需要更多证据支持。

sents.en: Matched treatment and control must share the restored state and continuation policy.
sents.zh: 匹配的治疗组与对照组必须共享恢复后的状态和延续策略。

sents.zh: 但这并不能保证其中任何一方能够重现源系统。

sents.zh: 表 14 根据源系统-执行器重演、替换的延续策略以及不完整的恢复情况，对当前的配对队列进行了分层分析。

sents.zh: 重复出现的分支结果和独特的因果关系需要更多证据支持。

paragraphs.en: Table 39 summarizes the evaluated recipes. We use conventional objectives; the data construction determines the visible history and supervised responses.
paragraphs.zh: 表 39 总结了经过评估的配方。 我们使用常规目标；数据构建决定了可见的历史和受监督的响应。

sents.en: Table 39 summarizes the evaluated recipes.
sents.zh: 表 39 总结了经过评估的配方。

sents.en: We use conventional objectives; the data construction determines the visible history and supervised responses.
sents.zh: 我们使用常规目标；数据构建决定了可见的历史和受监督的响应。

paragraphs.en: Equation 1 defines the diagnosis example-mean and actor token-mean objectives, with the mask selecting target assistant tokens. Appendix S reports the example-mean runtime check and its historical scope. These targets do not supervise a separate reasoning sidecar; Appendix I.14 describes the distinct reasoning-preserving construction.
paragraphs.zh: 方程 1 定义了诊断示例均值和智能体令牌均值目标，其中掩码用于选择目标助手令牌。 附录 S 报告了示例均值的运行时检查及其历史范围。 这些目标并不对独立的推理侧车进行监督；附录 I.14 描述了独特的保留推理的结构设计。

sents.en: Equation 1 defines the diagnosis example-mean and actor token-mean objectives, with the mask selecting target assistant tokens.
sents.zh: 方程 1 定义了诊断示例均值和智能体令牌均值目标，其中掩码用于选择目标助手令牌。

sents.en: Appendix S reports the example-mean runtime check and its historical scope.
sents.zh: 附录 S 报告了示例均值的运行时检查及其历史范围。

sents.en: These targets do not supervise a separate reasoning sidecar; Appendix I.14 describes the distinct reasoning-preserving construction.
sents.zh: 这些目标并不对独立的推理侧车进行监督；附录 I.14 描述了独特的保留推理的结构设计。

paragraphs.en: Each actor example uses the inference chat prefix and supervises one assistant response, including its end-of-turn token. We mask the history, observations and identifiable rejected actions; passing a branch does not validate each intermediate action. Loss averages over target tokens across all ranks in each optimizer window. Zero-loss padding avoids duplicating supervision. Composition excludes whole overlength rows without truncation; frozen training refuses unrecorded exclusions. Equal task exposure does not imply equal tokens, updates or compute.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体示例都使用推理聊天前缀，并监督一个助理的响应，包括其回合结束标记。 我们对历史、观察结果和可识别的被拒绝动作进行掩码；通过某个分支并不意味着每个中间动作都有效。 损失在所有优化器窗口中各个秩的目标标记上取平均值。 零损失填充可避免重复监督。 组合过程不包括未经截断的完整超长行；冻结训练拒绝未记录排除项。 任务暴露量相等并不意味着标记、更新或计算量也相等。

sents.en: Each actor example uses the inference chat prefix and supervises one assistant response, including its end-of-turn token.
sents.zh: 每个智能体示例都使用推理聊天前缀，并监督一个助理的响应，包括其回合结束标记。

sents.en: We mask the history, observations and identifiable rejected actions; passing a branch does not validate each intermediate action.
sents.zh: 我们对历史、观察结果和可识别的被拒绝动作进行掩码；通过某个分支并不意味着每个中间动作都有效。

sents.en: Loss averages over target tokens across all ranks in each optimizer window.
sents.zh: 损失在所有优化器窗口中各个秩的目标标记上取平均值。

sents.en: Zero-loss padding avoids duplicating supervision.
sents.zh: 零损失填充可避免重复监督。

sents.en: Composition excludes whole overlength rows without truncation; frozen training refuses unrecorded exclusions.
sents.zh: 组合过程不包括未经截断的完整超长行；冻结训练拒绝未记录排除项。

sents.en: Equal task exposure does not imply equal tokens, updates or compute.
sents.zh: 任务暴露量相等并不意味着标记、更新或计算量也相等。

paragraphs.en: For the post-error mixture, we reuse the pre-error passing continuation after checking a state-preserving adapter rejection and equal recorded task-state snapshots, excluding bookkeeping fields. We insert the source error and rejection as masked context. We construct reflection text from the recorded explanation, filtering later-step references, future-only words and hindsight phrases. This heuristic does not prove prefix support. The reflection is supervised text in the corrected response’s Thought: field, not a native model reasoning channel. The action-only control retains the same error, feedback, corrections and masks, and removes only this inserted reflection; its target-token budget therefore differs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于错误后的混合状态，在验证了状态保留的适配器拒绝以及记录的任务状态快照相等（排除记账字段）之后，我们重新使用错误前的通过延续。 我们将源错误和拒绝作为掩码上下文插入。 我们从记录的解释中构建反思文本，过滤掉后续步骤的引用、仅指未来的词语以及事后总结的短语。 这种启发式方法并未证明前缀支持。 该反思是修正后的响应中“思考：”字段内的监督文本，而非模型原生推理通道的内容。 仅包含动作的控制版本保留了相同的错误、反馈、修正和掩码，仅移除了此次插入的反思；因此其目标令牌预算有所不同。

sents.en: Action DPO uses the standard reference-relative log-probability objective ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) with a frozen, adapter-disabled base reference π ref \pi_{\rm ref} .

sents.en: For a shared prefix x x and chosen/rejected responses y + , y − y^{+},y^{-} , define r θ ​ ( x , y ) = log ⁡ π θ ​ ( y ∣ x ) − log ⁡ π ref ​ ( y ∣ x ) r_{\theta}(x,y)=\log\pi_{\theta}(y\mid x)-\log\pi_{\rm ref}(y\mid x) .
sents.zh: 对于共享前缀 x x 以及被选择/拒绝的响应 y + , y − y^{+},y^{-} ，定义 r θ ​ ( x , y ) = log ⁡ π θ ​ ( y ∣ x ) − log ⁡ π ref ​ ( y ∣ x ) r_{\theta}(x,y)=\log\pi_{\theta}(y\mid x)-\log\pi_{\rm ref}(y\mid x) 。

sents.en: With scale β > 0 \beta>0 and logistic function σ \sigma ,
sents.zh: 使用缩放因子 β > 0 \beta>0 和逻辑斯蒂函数 σ \sigma ，

paragraphs.en: The sequence log-probabilities sum response-token terms. This offline objective does not turn the historical pilot into a qualified recovery experiment.

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis reports exact-step accuracy, accuracy within five steps, and parse rate. Repair reports tool-name, argument, and complete-action accuracy; these offline proxies do not replace execution with an environment verifier. Each view uses the full expected cohort: missing predictions count as incorrect, while present-prediction scores are separate. Duplicate or foreign predictions are rejected. Corrected v6 views pass visible-target checks.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断报告包含精确步骤准确率、五步内准确率和解析率。 修复报告包含工具名称、参数和完整操作准确率；这些离线代理指标不能替代使用环境验证器进行执行。 每个视图均使用完整的预期队列：缺失的预测计为错误，而存在预测的得分则单独计算。 重复或外来的预测将被拒绝。 经过修正的 v6 视图通过可见目标检查。

sents.en: Diagnosis reports exact-step accuracy, accuracy within five steps, and parse rate.
sents.zh: 诊断报告包含精确步骤准确率、五步内准确率和解析率。

sents.en: Repair reports tool-name, argument, and complete-action accuracy; these offline proxies do not replace execution with an environment verifier.
sents.zh: 修复报告包含工具名称、参数和完整操作准确率；这些离线代理指标不能替代使用环境验证器进行执行。

sents.en: Each view uses the full expected cohort: missing predictions count as incorrect, while present-prediction scores are separate.
sents.zh: 每个视图均使用完整的预期队列：缺失的预测计为错误，而存在预测的得分则单独计算。

sents.en: Duplicate or foreign predictions are rejected.
sents.zh: 重复或外来的预测将被拒绝。

sents.en: Corrected v6 views pass visible-target checks.
sents.zh: 经过修正的 v6 视图通过可见目标检查。

paragraphs.en: Who&When is reported separately for Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated cases. AgentErrorBench uses a 1-based agent-step index, not individual message indices, and predicts a failure module rather than a responsible agent. Within each comparison, checkpoints share the source-specific prompt and rendering version. TrajErrBench retains its source message indices and error-module labels. MAST uses separate multilabel metrics against released o1 judge labels.
paragraphs.zh: 手工生成和算法生成的案例中，“谁”和“何时”会分别报告。 AgentErrorBench 使用基于 1 的智能体步数索引，而非单个消息索引，并且预测的是故障模块，而非责任智能体。 在每次比较中，检查点共享特定于来源的提示词和渲染版本。 TrajErrBench 保留其来源消息索引和错误模块标签。 MAST 使用独立的多元标签指标与已发布的 o1 裁判标签进行对比。

paragraphs.en: All-case accuracy counts provider errors and non-answers as incorrect; parsed accuracy and contract rate are separate. Gold steps outside the rendered context remain in the operational all-case denominator; source-invalid gold is separately identified. Label-visible sensitivity and position baselines use explicitly matched cases. Manifest labels must distinguish attributed failure, verified recovery point, and an earliest point established by an explicit search; replay at one point cannot certify earliestness.
paragraphs.zh: 全案例准确率将提供商错误和非回答视为不正确；解析准确率和合同率则单独计算。 超出渲染上下文的黄金步骤仍保留在操作层面的全案例分母中；来源无效的黄金数据会被单独识别。 标签可见敏感性和位置基线使用明确匹配的案例。 显式标签必须区分归因失败、已验证的恢复点，以及通过显式搜索确定的最早时间点；仅在一个时间点重复操作无法证明其最早性。

paragraphs.en: A single successful replacement with a failed control can fail to reproduce. We replayed both actions on 126 126 rows selected for certification after a revision. The certified action passed again on 85 85 rows, while the full success/failure contrast repeated on 66 66 . Selection after a successful revision limits both rates to this cohort.
paragraphs.zh: 仅用一次成功的替换替代一次失败的控制操作，可能无法重现结果。 在修订后，我们在经选定的 126 行数据上重新执行了这两种操作。 经认证的操作在 85 行数据上再次通过，而完全成功与失败的对比则在 66 行数据上重复出现。 在成功修订后的选择将两种比率都限制在该群体内。

paragraphs.en: The revised action outperformed the first proposal among rows where the first proposal had failed; the advantage disappeared where it had passed but its control also passed. Same-action repeats showed stochastic reversals. These observations support retaining control outcomes and trial counts. They do not isolate a causal benefit of revision or provide a corpus-wide replication rate.
paragraphs.zh: 在首个提案失败的行中，修订后的行动表现优于首个提案；而在首个提案通过但其控制方案也通过的行中，这种优势则消失了。 相同行动的重复出现了随机逆转。 这些观察结果支持保留控制结果和试验次数。 它们并未明确揭示修订的因果性益处，也未提供整个语料库范围内的复现率。

paragraphs.en: We intersect source attempts across both constructions and target formats before selecting one shared failure per task. Deterministic hashes choose the attempt and remove incomplete optimizer batches, independently of target labels. The resulting arms each contain 168 168 tasks in 17 17 task families, with identical inputs within each format and checked supervision masks. Joint admission limits the comparison to examples that both procedures can render. Table 40 gives update and token budgets; the observed seed-matched uncertainty is below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在选择每个任务中一个共同的失败之前，会跨两种构建和两种目标格式对源尝试进行交叉验证。 确定性哈希会选择尝试并移除不完整的优化器批次，且与目标标签无关。 最终得到的每个分支都包含 168×168 个任务，分布在 17×17 个任务族中，每种格式内的输入完全相同，并且监督掩码也已验证。 联合准入机制将比较范围限制在两种流程都能生成的示例上。 表 40 列出了更新和标记的预算；观察到的种子匹配不确定性如下所示。

paragraphs.en: The frozen internal labels use heterogeneous consensus. The metadata for the 943 943 holdout rows and the 948 948 - and 1,656 1{,}656 -task training manifests records Gemini 3.6 Flash as the consensus arbiter. This field does not identify the sole author of each label: the engine returns a winning voter’s diagnosis and calls the arbiter when voters lack a majority. Thus internal teacher-label agreement measures fit to the consensus annotations, including shared conventions and label errors. The prompted references receive no fine-tuning on these labels; the comparison cannot establish an independent-label capability ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的内部标签使用异构共识机制。 943 943 条保留行的元数据以及 948 948 和 1,656 1{,}656 任务训练清单均将 Gemini 3.6 Flash 记录为共识仲裁者。 该字段并未标识每个标签的唯一作者：引擎会返回获胜投票者的诊断结果，并在投票者未形成多数时调用仲裁者。 因此，内部教师与标签的一致性度量反映了其与共识标注的契合度，包括共享的规范以及标签错误。 提示引用的模型并未针对这些标签进行微调；因此，该比较无法确立独立标签能力的排名。

paragraphs.en: The diagnosis trainer specifies Eq. 1 . Running its training code path on CPU with unequal-length examples over a three-step accumulation window, the loss matches the per-example-mean reference to within 4.7 × 10 − 8 4.7\times 10^{-8} and the accumulated gradient to within 4.9 × 10 − 8 4.9\times 10^{-8} . The match depends on the setting that switches off the library’s default token-count normalisation: without it the same trainer optimises a window token mean, which on the test batch is 0.164 0.164 away in loss. The GPU’s fused cross-entropy kernel is not exercised by the CPU test; its reduction is read from code.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断训练器指定了公式 1。 在 CPU 上运行其训练代码路径，使用不等长示例并在三步累积窗口中进行训练，损失值与每个示例的平均参考值之差不超过 4.7 × 10⁻⁸（4.7\times 10^{-8}），累积梯度与参考值之差不超过 4.9 × 10⁻⁸（4.9\times 10^{-8}）。 这种匹配依赖于关闭了库中默认词元计数归一化的设置：若未关闭，同一训练器将优化窗口内的平均词元数，在测试批次中，该值与参考值的损失差异为 0.164（0.164）。 GPU 的融合交叉熵内核在 CPU 测试中并未被使用；其归约操作是从代码中读取的。

paragraphs.en: The power analysis assumes within-family correlation rather than estimating it. Task families are unequal, and accounting for this dependence increases the detectable effect relative to an independent-pairs calculation. Adequate power for the registered effect is not established. We retain the endpoint and use the observed clustered intervals below; a null contrast does not establish equivalence. The full assumption-dependent calculations remain archived.
paragraphs.zh: 该功效分析假设了家庭内部的相关性，而非对其进行估计。 任务类别并不均等，考虑这种依赖性会使可检测到的效应相较于独立配对计算有所增强。 尚未确定注册效应所需的有效功效。 我们保留终点指标，并使用下文观察到的聚类区间；零对比并不能确立等效性。 所有依赖假设的计算结果仍被存档。

paragraphs.en: Only the compact format is required for the primary experiment. Both arms use a microbatch of one, accumulation over 12 12 tasks, and the same learning-rate and epoch candidates. Loss is specified to average over target tokens within each task, then over tasks. Targets need not have equal length, so task exposure and update counts are matched rather than token budgets. The six checkpoints have completed training and evaluation under the trainer their manifests name. Their input contract masks targets from the context and withholds verifier information. The historical training runs did not log a runtime assertion of the loss reduction. The CPU unit check validates the tested implementation, not the historical GPU execution.
paragraphs.zh: 主实验仅要求使用紧凑格式。 两个分支均使用大小为 1 的微批量，在 12 个任务上进行累积，并采用相同的学習率与轮次候选值。 损失函数被指定为在每个任务内对目标词元取平均，然后跨任务再次取平均。 目标不必具有相同长度，因此任务暴露次数和更新次数会被匹配，而非依据词元预算。 六个检查点在 trainer 的 manifests 名称下已完成训练与评估。 其输入契约会从上下文中屏蔽目标，并隐藏验证器信息。 历史训练运行未记录损失减少的运行时间断言。 CPU 单元检查验证的是当前测试的实现，而非历史上的 GPU 执行过程。

paragraphs.en: Every interval contains zero; none is multiplicity adjusted. Family resampling describes evaluation uncertainty, while seed standard deviations describe training variation. Reusing the holdout adds no independent tasks. Between 17 17 and 27 27 cases change correctness relative to base, with gains and losses largely offset. The null therefore establishes neither unchanged behavior nor equivalence; its cause remains unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 每个区间都包含零；没有哪个的重复性被调整。 家族重采样描述了评估不确定性，而种子标准差则描述了训练中的变化。 重复使用预留集并未增加任何独立任务。 在 17 17 到 27 27 个案例中，正确性与基线相比发生了变化，其中增益和损失基本相互抵消。 因此，该零假设既未确立行为不变，也未确立等价性；其成因仍然未解。

paragraphs.en: A source trace stores task identity, goal, environment, policy, harness, event sequence, terminal outcome, and verifier signal. A debugging attempt joins to that trace and stores attribution, evidence spans, proposed correction, replay samples, and construction provenance. Several attempts may share one trace. Identity conflicts are rejected; identical repeated source rows can be merged without discarding distinct attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 源轨迹存储任务身份、目标、环境、策略、测试框架、事件序列、终端结果和验证器信号。 一次调试尝试会与该轨迹关联，并存储归因、证据跨度、建议的修正、重播样本和构建来源。 多次尝试可能共享同一条轨迹。 身份冲突将被拒绝；相同的重复源行可以合并，而不会丢弃不同的尝试。

paragraphs.en: The frozen release materializes one of these views. Its diagnosis view holds 3157 3157 training rows beside 219 219 development and 943 943 held-out rows, and the four views that require an executed branch hold nothing: of the 9715 9715 attempts pooled at export, 9712 9712 were never replayed, so the gate that asks for a control arm empties them by construction rather than by attrition. The release is a natural-failure corpus in which replay is optional. Preference pools from earlier development packages are separate from this frozen release.
paragraphs.zh: 这个冻结版本实现了其中一种视图。 它的诊断视图包含 3157 个训练行、219 个开发行和 943 个预留行，而需要执行分支的四种视图则不包含任何数据：在导出时汇总的 9715 次尝试中，有 9712 次从未被重播，因此要求对照组的机制通过设计而非淘汰使这些数据为空。 这个版本是一个自然失败语料库，其中重播是可选的。 早期开发包中的偏好池与此冻结版本相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis-data selection distinguishes deliberately disabled replay from a truncated or failed construction job. It preserves the same attribution target when replay is added or removed. Reference-assisted labels are privileged-teacher supervision: student inputs omit the reference, and metadata records its provenance and lack of availability at inference. This is not equivalent to unassisted label construction.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断数据的选择能够区分故意禁用的重放与截断或失败的构建任务。 无论是否添加或移除重放，它都保持相同的归因目标。 参考辅助标签属于特权教师监督：学生输入中不包含参考信息，而元数据则记录了其来源以及在推理阶段无法获取的情况。 这与无辅助的标签构建并不等价。

paragraphs.en: ADP standardizes what agents did ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; AED standardizes a proposed attribution of what went wrong and a proposed correction, with execution evidence where a replay ran. Using the implemented conversion procedure, 672 of 672 rows export their failing trajectory as an ADP trajectory. Under the exporter’s stated definition, 0 of 672 rows lose information: a tool call has non-keyword arguments or no tool name, or an observation is truncated. For trajectory-level training, those exported rows pass the tested ADP schema and the enumerated loss checks; use by other ADP consumers was not tested. For diagnosis, AED adds fields that ADP has no home for: the blamed step, grounded quotes, the replacement action, and a matched replay with its verdict. The conversion was measured over every certification dataset produced by the fixed-harness pipeline; ADP-side schema validation was structural, since the protocol’s own validator was not available on the measurement host. Table 42 lists what an ADP trajectory stores and what an AED record adds.
paragraphs.zh: ADP 标准化了智能体的行为（Song 等人，2026）；AED 则标准化了对问题所在的一项拟议归因和一项拟议的修正，并在重播执行时提供了执行证据。 通过已实施的转换流程，672 行数据中的全部 672 行都将其失败的轨迹导出为 ADP 轨迹。 根据导出工具所声明的定义，672 行数据中没有任何一行会丢失信息：即工具调用不存在非关键词参数或没有工具名称，或者观察结果未被截断。 在轨迹级训练中，这些导出的行通过了测试的 ADP 模式和枚举的损失检查；但其他 ADP 消费者的使用情况并未经过测试。 在诊断方面，AED 增加了 ADP 无法容纳的字段：被归咎的步骤、有依据的引文、替代动作，以及带有判决结果的匹配重播。 该转换过程在所有由固定夹具流程生成的认证数据集上进行了测量；ADP 侧的模式验证仅为结构验证，因为协议自身的验证器在测量主机上不可用。 表 42 列出了 ADP 轨迹所存储的内容以及 AED 记录所增加的内容。

paragraphs.en: Both reviewers select a preferred error step on 69 / 80 69/80 records, including cases with multiple defensible candidates. They select the same step on 59 / 69 59/69 ( 85.5 % 85.5\% ; 95% interval [ 75.3 , 91.9 ] [75.3,91.9] ). The remaining 11 11 records include at least one nonlocalizable, no-error or insufficient-evidence judgment; we retain them in the study but do not count them as matched steps. Among the 50 50 records where both select a single step, reviewers agree on 46 / 50 46/50 records ( 92.0 % 92.0\% ; 95% interval [ 81.2 , 96.8 ] [81.2,96.8] ). On the full 80 80 -record denominator, both preferred steps match the recorded diagnosis on 57 / 80 57/80 records; this measures alignment with that diagnosis, not independently established correctness. At least one reviewer reports insufficient information on 4 / 80 4/80 records.
paragraphs.zh: 两位评审员在 69 / 80 69/80 条记录中均选出了首选错误步骤，其中包括存在多个合理候选情况的情形。 他们在 59 / 69 59/69 条记录（85.5 % 85.5\%；95% 置信区间 [75.3, 91.9]）中选择了相同的步骤。 其余 11 条记录至少包含一条无法定位、无错误或证据不足的判断；我们在研究中保留这些记录，但不将其计为匹配步骤。 在两位评审员均选择单一步骤的 50 条记录中，他们一致同意 46 / 50 条记录（92.0 % 92.0\%；95% 置信区间 [81.2, 96.8]）。 在整个 80 条记录的样本中，两位评审员的首选步骤与记录中的诊断在 57 / 80 条记录中一致；这衡量的是与该诊断的一致性，而非独立验证的正确性。 至少有一位评审员在 4 / 80 条记录中指出信息不足。

paragraphs.en: The 160 160 individual verdicts comprise 109 109 accept, 43 43 revise, 4 4 reject and 4 4 insufficient-information judgments. paragraphs.en: Four raters, identified only as A–D, each received 40 40 records; every record was assigned to two raters ( 80 80 distinct records, 160 160 assignments). The raters were paper authors with doctoral or AI/LLM research backgrounds and participated voluntarily. The sample contains 48 48 filter survivors, 16 16 judge-rejected records and 16 16 gate-rejected records from a historical collection frame. It spans 30 30 environments, including 31 31 records outside the released core. The frame contains 28,432 28{,}432 rows; the 40,000 40{,}000 -character reading cap excludes 1,255 1{,}255 rows. Sampling retains one record per source task and trace. Pair overlaps are AB= 14 14 , AC= 13 13 , AD= 13 13 , BC= 13 13 , BD= 13 13 and CD= 14 14 . Each rater receives only their assigned packet in a fixed order. This coverage-selected sample is separate from the final collection census, the diagnosis test set and the same-task construction comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 四名评分者（仅以 A–D 标识）每人收到了 40 条记录；每条记录都分配给了两名评分者（共 80 条不同记录，160 次分配）。 这些评分者均为论文作者，拥有博士学位或人工智能/大语言模型研究背景，且自愿参与。 该样本包含 48 条通过筛选的记录、16 条被评审拒绝的记录以及 16 条被入口审查拒绝的记录，均来自一个历史数据集框架。 该样本覆盖了 30 个环境，其中包括 31 条未包含在已发布核心数据中的记录。 该框架包含 28,432 行；40,000 字符的文本阅读上限排除了 1,255 行。 抽样时保留每个源任务和追踪路径的一条记录。 成对重叠情况为：AB=14、AC=13、AD=13、BC=13、BD=13 和 CD=14。 每位评分者仅按固定顺序收到自己分配的数据包。 这个通过覆盖范围选择的样本与最终数据集普查、诊断测试集以及同一任务的构建对比数据相互独立。

paragraphs.en: GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 receive the same trace, reference and recorded diagnosis without seeing each other’s response. Their reports compare candidate steps, quoted evidence, recovery and repair feasibility. Both humans assigned to a record see identical assistance. We imported 158 158 real reports: 78 78 cases have both models; two have Astra alone because the Fable calls failed. These omissions do not remove records or human assignments. Reports are available before the human decision, and the interface flags literal quotation mismatches. This is AI-assisted human verification by author volunteers; shared advice and involvement in the project can influence judgments. It is not independent external validation. Figure 19 shows an English paper view of the workbench.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-6 Astra 和 Fable 5.1 接收到相同的追踪信息、参考信息和记录诊断，但彼此看不到对方的回应。 它们的报告比较了候选步骤、引用的证据以及恢复与修复的可行性。 被分配至某条记录的两个人类都看到了完全相同的辅助信息。 我们导入了 158 份真实报告：其中 78 个案例包含两种模型；另外两个案例仅包含 Astra，因为 Fable 的调用失败了。 这些遗漏并不会删除记录或改变人类分配情况。 在人类做出决定之前，报告就已经可用，并且界面会标记出逐字引用不匹配的情况。 这是由作者志愿者进行的 AI 辅助人类验证；共享的建议以及参与项目本身可能会影响判断。 这并非独立的第三方验证。 图 19 展示了工作台的英文论文视图。

paragraphs.en: We retain both original judgments without replacing disagreements by consensus. Missing judgments are never replaced with model responses. Joint acceptance requires two accept verdicts. Raw verdict agreement compares the four response categories, including insufficient information. We report raw agreement separately for localization and diagnosis content because they concern different annotation targets ( Artstein and Poesio, 2008 ) . Preferred-step agreement compares step IDs within the same record , conditional on both reviewers selecting a location; it includes each reviewer’s preferred choice when several steps are defensible. We also report the subset where both choose a single step. We retain abstention and nonlocalizable responses in the full study count and state each conditional denominator. Rate intervals are Wilson 95% intervals. They summarize these sampled records under the fixed raters and shared assistance, without a collection-wide accuracy interpretation. Agreement does not establish correctness against an independent reference label.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留所有原始判断，不会用共识取代不一致的判断。 缺失的判断绝不会被模型的回答所替代。 联合接受需要两个“接受”的判定结果。 原始判定一致性比较了四种回应类别，包括信息不足的情况。 我们对定位和诊断内容的原始一致性分别报告，因为它们涉及不同的标注目标（Artstein and Poesio, 2008）。 首选步骤一致性比较同一记录内的步骤 ID，前提是两位评审员都选择了某个位置；当多个步骤都有合理性时，它也包括每位评审员的首选。 我们还报告了两位评审员都选择单个步骤的子集情况。 我们在完整研究统计中保留了弃权和非可定位的回应，并说明了每个条件分母。 比率区间为威尔逊 95% 置信区间。 这些抽样记录在固定评分员和共享协助的条件下进行了汇总，但并未对整个数据集的准确性进行解释。 一致性并不等同于与独立参考标签相比的正确性。

paragraphs.en: We retain the alternative prompts in Table 52 . The diagnosis student loses exact-step accuracy in all original Who&When prompt conditions. Training-format evaluation also retains losses; answer-format continuation improves the hand-crafted split but remains below the base on algorithm-generated tasks. AgentErrorBench improvements in point estimates have no clear paired advantage in the existing tests. Prompt choice changes the comparison and does not establish public state-of-the-art performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了表 52 中的替代提示。 在所有的原始“Who&When”提示条件下，诊断学生在精确步骤准确性方面均出现下降。 训练格式评估也保留了性能损失；答案格式续写虽然改进了人工设计的分割方式，但在算法生成的任务中仍低于基线模型。 AgentErrorBench 在点估计方面的改进，在现有测试中并未展现出明确的配对优势。 提示的选择改变了比较基准，但并未确立公开的当前最佳性能。

paragraphs.en: Who&When contains 58 hand-crafted and 126 algorithm-generated cases. Gold conditions supply the task reference answer, never the attribution label. Agent accuracy uses canonicalised exact match, which is stricter than the benchmark’s substring scorer; step accuracy uses native coordinates. AgentErrorBench contains 100 ALFWorld, 50 WebShop and 50 GAIA cases. Its macro score weights the three environments equally. Joint accuracy requires both step and module to match; it is undefined for a step-only request.
paragraphs.zh: Who&When 包含 58 个手工构建的案例和 126 个算法生成的案例。 Gold 条件提供任务的参考答案，但从不提供归属标签。 智能体准确率采用规范化的精确匹配，这比基准测试中的子字符串评分器更严格；步骤准确率则使用原始坐标。 AgentErrorBench 包含 100 个 ALFWorld 案例、50 个 WebShop 案例和 50 个 GAIA 案例。 其宏观分数对三种环境给予相等的权重。 联合准确率要求步骤和模块均匹配；对于仅包含步骤的请求，该指标无定义。

paragraphs.en: The diagnosis student is the 948-task, seed-17 full-diagnosis checkpoint. Answer-format diversity continues it for one epoch with mixed target formats, changing both training exposure and format coverage. We evaluate one checkpoint per arm under the v6 adapters with budget-forced decoding, without checkpoint selection on these public splits. Published system scores and older-protocol results are separate references, not entries in these same-protocol columns. The compact-target AED and AgenTracer-data resource comparison uses a different answer contract and remains separate from this protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断学生是 948 任务、种子为 17 的完整诊断检查点。 在混合目标格式下，答案格式的多样性会持续一个周期，从而改变训练接触度和格式覆盖范围。 在 v6 适配器下，我们对每个分支的一个检查点进行评估，采用预算强制解码，且在这些公开数据分割上不进行检查点选择。 已发布的系统分数和旧协议的结果是独立的参考信息，并非这些相同协议列中的条目。 紧凑目标 AED 与 AgenTracer 数据资源的比较使用了不同的答案契约，并且与本协议保持独立。

paragraphs.en: Success-only supervision compiles to 1,093 1{,}093 rows over 1,093 1{,}093 tasks and 710,083 710{,}083 supervised tokens per epoch. Each repair arm contains 1,790 1{,}790 rows over 1,183 1{,}183 tasks: preventive and action-only use 705,776 705{,}776 tokens per epoch, while reflective uses 714,111 714{,}111 . These aggregate token budgets are similar, but task coverage and per-environment exposure differ. Preventive repair carries 8.25 % 8.25\% more supervised tokens than success-only in text-to-SQL and 13.69 % 13.69\% fewer in WebShop-lite, and the two arms sit within 0.29 % 0.29\% in TextQuest. The repair arms also take 1,490 1{,}490 optimizer updates against success-only’s 1,326 1{,}326 . Every Δ \Delta below therefore carries supervision type together with per-environment exposure and update count.
paragraphs.zh: 仅成功监督模式在 1,093 个任务中生成 1,093 行数据，每个周期包含 710,083 个受监督的标记。 每个修复分支包含 1,790 行数据，覆盖 1,183 个任务：预防式和仅行动式在每个周期中使用 705,776 个标记，而反思式则使用 714,111 个标记。 这些总标记预算相近，但任务覆盖范围和每个环境的暴露程度存在差异。 在文本转 SQL 任务中，预防式修复比仅成功监督模式多使用 8.25% 的受监督标记；在 WebShop-lite 任务中则少使用 13.69%；而在 TextQuest 任务中，两种分支的差异在 0.29% 以内。 修复分支还需要 1,490 次优化器更新，而仅成功监督模式仅需 1,326 次。 因此，以下每个 Δ 都同时包含了监督类型、每个环境的暴露程度以及更新次数。

paragraphs.en: A post-hoc Holm sensitivity across all 18 repair-versus-reference tests retains the WebShop-lite action-only and reflective gains (adjusted p = 0.0115 and 0.0080), and all three TextQuest losses. The preventive WebShop gain does not survive this adjustment (p = 0.5663). This addresses multiplicity, not training-seed replication, checkpoint provenance or causal identification.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 18 项修复与参考测试中进行的事后 Holm 敏感性分析保留了 WebShop-lite 的仅行动增益和反思性增益（调整后的 p 值分别为 0.0115 和 0.0080），以及 TextQuest 的全部三项损失。 预防性的 WebShop 增益未能通过此调整（p = 0.5663）。 此举解决了多重性问题，而非训练种子复制、检查点来源或因果识别问题。

paragraphs.en: One driver served the base policy and the preventive-repair arm on the same port with the same arguments, then ran both on real ALFWorld and real ScienceWorld. The base policy solves 8 / 134 8/134 real ALFWorld tasks ( 5.97 % 5.97\% ) and 29 / 300 29/300 real ScienceWorld tasks ( 9.67 % 9.67\% ); the repair arm solves 1 / 134 1/134 ( 0.75 % 0.75\% ) and 1 / 294 1/294 ( 0.34 % 0.34\% ), losses of 5.22 5.22 and 9.33 9.33 points. Six ScienceWorld episodes ended in run errors and leave that arm’s denominator at 294 294 . The same base policy scores 88.00 88.00 on the development harness’s ALFWorld-lite, so the harness and the real environment measure different things rather than one task at two difficulty levels, and Table 49 reports gains on the development harness only. We do not measure whether the loss comes from format specialization, from forgetting the base policy’s interaction style, or from an interface mismatch between the two environments. This real-environment comparison concerns the preventive-repair arm alone.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体在同一端口、使用相同参数运行了基础策略和预防性维修分支，随后在真实的 ALFWorld 和真实的 ScienceWorld 中同时运行两者。 基础策略解决了 8 / 134 个真实 ALFWorld 任务（5.97%）和 29 / 300 个真实 ScienceWorld 任务（9.67%）；维修分支则仅解决了 1 / 134 个任务（0.75%）和 1 / 294 个任务（0.34%），分别损失了 5.22 分和 9.33 分。 有六个 ScienceWorld 回合因运行时错误而终止，因此该分支的分母仍为 294。 同一基础策略在开发工具包中的 ALFWorld-lite 上获得了 88.00 分，因此该工具包与真实环境衡量的是不同的事物，而非同一任务在不同难度水平上的表现；表 49 仅报告了开发工具包上的增益。 我们并未衡量这种损失是源于格式特化、忘记了基础策略的交互风格，还是两个环境之间的接口不匹配。 这一真实环境比较仅涉及预防性维修分支。
